                                   nd_period=nd_period,
                                   lead_time=nd_lead,
                                   **kwargs[obs_type])
    else:  # track is default
        if nd_period is not None:
            user_logger.trace(
                "TRACE: ts before nd trigger" "{} for {}".format(time.time(), nd_period)
            )
            noisediode.trigger(session.kat,
                               duration=nd_period,
                               lead_time=nd_lead)
            user_logger.trace("TRACE: ts after nd trigger {}".format(time.time()))

def cadence_target(target_list):

            if target["last_observed"] is None:
                return target
            delta_time = time.time() - target["last_observed"]
            if delta_time > target["cadence"]:
                return target
    return False
def above_horizon(target,
                  observer,
                  horizon=20.0,
                  duration=0.0):
    """Check target visibility.
       Utility function to calculate ephem horizontal coordinates
    """
    # use local copies so you do not overwrite target time attribute
    horizon = ephem.degrees(str(horizon))
    # must be celestial target (ra, dec)
    # check that target is visible at start of track
    start_ = timestamp2datetime(time.time())
    [azim, elev] = _horizontal_coordinates(target,
                                              observer,
                                              start_)
    user_logger.trace(
        "TRACE: target at start (az, el)= ({}, {})".format(azim, elev)
    )
    if not elev > horizon:
        return False
    # check that target will be visible at end of track
    if duration:
        end_ = timestamp2datetime(time.time() + duration)
        [azim, elev] = _horizontal_coordinates(target,
                                                  observer,
                                                  end_)
        user_logger.trace(
            "TRACE: target at end (az, el)= ({}, {})".format(azim, elev)
        )
        return elev > horizon
    return True
class Telescope(object):
    """The telescope class.
    Settings for the telescope components
    """
    def __init__(self, opts, correlator=None):
        user_logger.info("Setting up telescope for observation")
        self.opts = opts
        # unpack user specified correlator setup values
        if correlator is not None:
            correlator_config = read_yaml(correlator)
            self.feng = correlator_config["Fengine"]
            self.xeng = correlator_config["Xengine"]
            self.beng = correlator_config["Bengine"]
        else:
            self.feng = self.xeng = self.beng = None
        # Check options and build KAT configuration,
        # connecting to proxies and devices
        # create single kat object, cannot repeatedly recreate
        self.array = verify_and_connect(opts)
    def __enter__(self):
        """Verify subarray setup correct for observation before doing any work."""
        user_logger.info("Observation start up")
        user_logger.info("Running astrokat version - %s", astrokat.__version__)
        obs_plan_params = self.opts.obs_plan_params
        if "instrument" in obs_plan_params:
            self.subarray_setup(obs_plan_params["instrument"])
        # TODO: noise diode implementations should be moved to sessions
        # switch noise-source pattern off (known setup starting observation)
        noisediode.off(self.array)
        # TODO: update correlator settings
        # TODO: names of antennas to use for beamformer if not all is desirable
        return self
    def __exit__(self, type, value, traceback):
        """Return telescope to its startup state."""
        user_logger.info("Observation clean up")
        user_logger.info("Returning telescope to startup state")
        # Ensure known exit state before quitting
        # TODO: Return correlator settings to entry values
        # switch noise-source pattern off (ensure this after each observation)
        # if NaN returned at off command, allow to continue
        noisediode.off(self.array, allow_ts_err=True)
        self.array.disconnect()
    def subarray_setup(self, instrument):
        """Set up the array for observing.
        Include current sensor list in instrument.
        Parameters
        ----------
        instrument: dict
            An object specifying the configuration of the correlator and frontend
            resources to set up telescope for observing
            e.g {pool_resources, product, dump_rate, band}. Where
                pool_resources = ptuse or specific antennas
                product = correlator product
                dump_rate = correlator data dumprate
                band = observing frequency band (l, s, u, x)
        """
        user_logger.trace(self.opts.obs_plan_params["instrument"])
        if self.opts.obs_plan_params["instrument"] is None:
            return
        approved_sb_sensor = self.array.sched.sensor.get("approved_schedule")
        if not approved_sb_sensor:
            user_logger.info(
                "Skipping instrument checks - approved_schedule does not exist"
            )
            return
        approved_sb_sensor_value = approved_sb_sensor.get_value()
        if self.array.sb_id_code not in approved_sb_sensor_value:
            user_logger.info(
                "Skipping instrument checks - {} "
                "not in approved_schedule".format(self.array.sb_id_code)
            )
            return
        for key in instrument.keys():
            conf_param = instrument[key]
            user_logger.trace("{}: {}".format(key, conf_param))
            sensor_name = "sub_{}".format(key)
            user_logger.trace("{}".format(sensor_name))
            sub_sensor = self.array.sensor.get(sensor_name).get_value()
            if isinstance(conf_param, list):
                conf_param = set(conf_param)
            if isinstance(sub_sensor, list):
                sub_sensor = set(sub_sensor)
            if key == "product" and conf_param in sub_sensor:
                continue
            elif key == "pool_resources":
                if conf_param == "available":
                    continue
                pool_params = [str_.strip() for str_ in conf_param.split(",")]
                for param in pool_params:
                    if param not in sub_sensor:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "Subarray configuration {} error, {} required, "
                            "{} found".format(sensor_name, param, sub_sensor)
                        )
            elif key == "dump_rate":
                delta = abs(conf_param - sub_sensor)
                if delta > DUMP_RATE_TOLERANCE:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "Subarray configuration {} error, {} required, "
                        "{} found, delta > tolerance ({} > {})".format(
                            sensor_name, conf_param, sub_sensor, delta,
                            DUMP_RATE_TOLERANCE)
                    )
            elif conf_param != sub_sensor:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Subarray configuration {} error, {} required, "
                    "{} found".format(sensor_name, conf_param, sub_sensor)
                )
def run_observation(opts, kat):
    """Extract control and observation information provided in observation file."""
    obs_plan_params = opts.obs_plan_params
    # remove observation specific instructions housed in YAML file
    del opts.obs_plan_params
    # set up duration periods for observation control
    obs_duration = -1
    if "durations" in obs_plan_params:
        if "obs_duration" in obs_plan_params["durations"]:
            obs_duration = obs_plan_params["durations"]["obs_duration"]
    # check for nonsensical observation duration setting
    if abs(obs_duration) < 1e-5:
        user_logger.error("Unexpected value: obs_duration: {}".format(obs_duration))
        return
    # TODO: the description requirement in sessions should be re-evaluated
    # since the schedule block has the description
    # Description argument in instruction_set should be retired, but is
    # needed by sessions
    # Assign proposal_description if available, else create a dummy
    if "description" not in vars(opts):
        session_opts = vars(opts)
        description = "Observation run"
        if "proposal_description" in vars(opts):
            description = opts.proposal_description
        session_opts["description"] = description
    nr_obs_loops = len(obs_plan_params["observation_loop"])
    with start_session(kat.array, **vars(opts)) as session:
        session.standard_setup(**vars(opts))
        # Each observation loop contains a number of observation cycles over LST ranges
        # For a single observation loop, only a start LST and duration is required
        # Target observation loop
        observation_timer = time.time()
        for obs_cntr, observation_cycle in enumerate(obs_plan_params["observation_loop"]):
            if nr_obs_loops > 1:
                user_logger.info("Observation loop {} of {}."
                                 .format(obs_cntr + 1, nr_obs_loops))
                user_logger.info("Loop LST range {}."
                                 .format(observation_cycle["LST"]))
            # Unpack all target information
            if not ("target_list" in observation_cycle.keys()):
                user_logger.error(
                    "No targets provided - stopping script instead of hanging around"
                )
                continue
            obs_targets = observation_cycle["target_list"]
            target_list = obs_targets["target"].tolist()
            # build katpoint catalogues for tidy handling of targets
            catalogue = collect_targets(kat.array, target_list)
            obs_tags = []
            for tgt in obs_targets:
                # catalogue names are no longer unique
                name = tgt["name"]
                # add tag evaluation to identify catalogue targets
                tags = tgt["target"].split(",")[1].strip()
                for cat_tgt in catalogue:
                    if name == cat_tgt.name:
                        if ("special" in cat_tgt.tags
                                or "xephem" in cat_tgt.tags
                                or tags == " ".join(cat_tgt.tags)):
                            tgt["target"] = cat_tgt
                            obs_tags.extend(cat_tgt.tags)
                            break
            obs_tags = list(set(obs_tags))
            cal_tags = [tag for tag in obs_tags if tag[-3:] == "cal"]
            # observer object handle to track the observation timing in a more user
            # friendly way
#             observer = catalogue._antenna.observer
            ref_antenna = catalogue.antenna
            observer = ref_antenna.observer
            start_datetime = timestamp2datetime(time.time())
            observer.date = ephem.Date(start_datetime)
            user_logger.trace(
                "TRACE: requested start time "
                "({}) {}".format(datetime2timestamp(start_datetime), start_datetime)
            )
            user_logger.trace("TRACE: observer at start\n {}".format(observer))
            # Only observe targets in valid LST range
            if nr_obs_loops > 1 and obs_cntr < nr_obs_loops - 1:
                [start_lst, end_lst] = get_lst(observation_cycle["LST"],
                                               multi_loop=True)
                if end_lst is None:
                    # for multi loop the end lst is required
                    raise RuntimeError('Multi-loop observations require end LST times')
                next_obs_plan = obs_plan_params["observation_loop"][obs_cntr + 1]
                [next_start_lst,
                 next_end_lst] = get_lst(next_obs_plan["LST"])
                user_logger.trace("TRACE: current LST range {}-{}".format(
                    ephem.hours(str(start_lst)),
                    ephem.hours(str(end_lst))))
                user_logger.trace("TRACE: next LST range {}-{}".format(
                    ephem.hours(str(next_start_lst)),
                    ephem.hours(str(next_end_lst))))
            else:
                next_start_lst = None
                next_end_lst = None
                [start_lst, end_lst] = get_lst(observation_cycle["LST"])
            # Verify the observation is in a valid LST range
            # and that it is worth while continuing with the observation
            # Do not use float() values, ephem.hours does not convert as
            # expected
            local_lst = observer.sidereal_time()
            user_logger.trace("TRACE: Local LST {}".format(ephem.hours(local_lst)))
            # Only observe targets in current LST range
            log_msg = "Local LST outside LST range {}-{}".format(
                      ephem.hours(str(start_lst)), ephem.hours(str(end_lst)))
            if float(start_lst) < end_lst:
                # lst ends before midnight
                if not _same_day(start_lst, end_lst, local_lst):
                    if obs_cntr < nr_obs_loops - 1:
                        user_logger.info(log_msg)
                    else:
                        user_logger.error(log_msg)
                    continue
            else:
                # lst ends after midnight
                if _next_day(start_lst, end_lst, local_lst):
                    if obs_cntr < nr_obs_loops - 1:
                        user_logger.info(log_msg)
                    else:
                        user_logger.error(log_msg)
                    continue
            # Verify that it is worth while continuing with the observation
            # The filter functions uses the current time as timestamps
            # and thus incorrectly set the simulation timestamp
            if not kat.array.dry_run:
                # Quit early if there are no sources to observe
                if len(catalogue.filter(el_limit_deg=opts.horizon)) == 0:
                    raise NoTargetsUpError(
                        "No targets are currently visible - "
                        "please re-run the script later"
                    )
                # Quit early if the observation requires all targets to be visible
                if opts.all_up and (
                    len(catalogue.filter(el_limit_deg=opts.horizon)) != len(catalogue)
                ):
                    raise NotAllTargetsUpError(
                        "Not all targets are currently visible - please re-run the script"
                        "with --visibility for information"
                    )
            # List sources and their associated functions from observation tags
            not_cals_filter_list = []
            for cal_type in cal_tags:
                not_cals_filter_list.append("~{}".format(cal_type))
                cal_array = [cal.name for cal in catalogue.filter(cal_type)]
                if len(cal_array) < 1:
                    continue  # do not display empty tags
                user_logger.info(
                    "{} calibrators are {}".format(str.upper(cal_type[:-3]), cal_array)
                )
            user_logger.info(
                "Observation targets are [{}]".format(
                    ", ".join(
                        [
                            repr(target.name)
                            for target in catalogue.filter(not_cals_filter_list)
                        ]
                    )
                )
            )
            # TODO: setup of noise diode pattern should be moved to sessions
            #  so it happens in the line above
            if "noise_diode" in obs_plan_params:
                nd_setup = obs_plan_params["noise_diode"]
                nd_lead = nd_setup.get('lead_time')
                # Set noise diode period to multiple of correlator integration time.
                if not kat.array.dry_run:
                    cbf_corr = session.cbf.correlator
                    dump_period = cbf_corr.sensor.int_time.get_value()
                else:
                    dump_period = 0.5  # sec
                user_logger.debug('DEBUG: Correlator integration time {} [sec]'
                                  .format(dump_period))
                if "cycle_len" in nd_setup:
                    if (nd_setup['cycle_len'] >= dump_period):
                        cycle_len_frac = nd_setup['cycle_len'] // dump_period
                        nd_setup['cycle_len'] = cycle_len_frac * dump_period
                        msg = ('Set noise diode period '
                               'to multiple of correlator dump period: '
                               'cycle length = {} [sec]'
                               .format(nd_setup['cycle_len']))
                    else:
                        msg = ('Requested cycle length {}s '
                               '< correlator dump period {}s, '
                               'ND not synchronised with dump edge'
                               .format(nd_setup['cycle_len'], dump_period))
                    user_logger.warning(msg)
                    noisediode.pattern(kat.array,
                                       nd_setup,
                                       lead_time=nd_lead,
                                       )
            # Adding explicit init after "Capture-init failed" exception was
            # encountered
            session.capture_init()
            user_logger.debug(
                "DEBUG: Initialise capture start with timestamp "
                "{} ({})".format(int(time.time()), timestamp2datetime(time.time()))
            )
            # Go to first target before starting capture
            user_logger.info("Slewing to first target")
            observe(session, ref_antenna, obs_targets[0], slewonly=True)
            # Only start capturing once we are on target
            session.capture_start()
            user_logger.trace(
                "TRACE: capture start time after slew "
                "({}) {}".format(time.time(), timestamp2datetime(time.time()))
            )
            user_logger.trace("TRACE: observer after slew\n {}".format(observer))
            done = False
            sanity_cntr = 0
            while not done:
                # small errors can cause an infinite loop here
                # preventing infinite loops
                sanity_cntr += 1
                if sanity_cntr > 100000:
                    user_logger.error(
                        "While limit counter has reached {}, "
                        "exiting".format(sanity_cntr)
                    )
                    break
                # Cycle through target list in order listed
                targets_visible = False
                time_remaining = obs_duration
                observation_timer = time.time()
                for tgt_cntr, target in enumerate(obs_targets):
                    katpt_target = target["target"]
                    user_logger.debug("DEBUG: {} {}".format(tgt_cntr, target))
                    user_logger.trace(
                        "TRACE: initial observer for target\n {}".format(observer)
                    )
                    # check target visible before doing anything
                    # make sure the target would be visible for the entire duration
                    target_duration = target['duration']
                    visible = True
                    if type(katpt_target.body) is ephem.FixedBody:
                        visible = above_horizon(target=katpt_target.body.copy(),
                                                observer=observer.copy(),
                                                horizon=opts.horizon,
                                                duration=target_duration)
                    if not visible:
                        show_horizon_status = True
                        # warning for cadence targets only when they are due
                        if (
                            target["cadence"] > 0
                            and target["last_observed"] is not None
                        ):
                            delta_time = time.time() - target["last_observed"]
                            show_horizon_status = delta_time >= target["cadence"]
                        if show_horizon_status:
                            user_logger.warn(
                                "Target {} below {} deg horizon, "
                                "continuing".format(target["name"], opts.horizon)
                            )
                        continue
                    user_logger.trace(
                        "TRACE: observer after horizon check\n {}".format(observer)
                    )
                    # check and observe all targets with cadences
                    while_cntr = 0
                    cadence_targets = list(obs_targets)
                    while True:
                        tgt = cadence_target(cadence_targets)
                        if not tgt:
                            break
                        # check enough time remaining to continue
                        if obs_duration > 0 and time_remaining < tgt["duration"]:
                            done = True
                            break
                        # check target visible before doing anything
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: cadence"
                            "target\n{}\n {}".format(tgt, catalogue[tgt["name"]])
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: initial observer for cadence"
                            "target\n {}".format(observer)
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: observer before track\n {}".format(observer)
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: target observation # {} last observed "
                            "{}".format(tgt["obs_cntr"], tgt["last_observed"])
                        )
                        cat_target = catalogue[tgt["name"]]
                        if above_horizon(target=cat_target.body,
                                         observer=cat_target.antenna.observer.copy(),
                                         horizon=opts.horizon,
                                         duration=tgt["duration"]):
                            if observe(session, ref_antenna, tgt, **obs_plan_params):
                                targets_visible += True
                                tgt["obs_cntr"] += 1
                                tgt["last_observed"] = time.time()
                            else:
                                # target not visibile to sessions anymore
                                cadence_targets.remove(tgt)
                            user_logger.trace(
                                "TRACE: observer after track\n {}".format(observer)
                            )
                            user_logger.trace(
                                "TRACE: target observation # {} last observed "
                                "{}".format(tgt["obs_cntr"], tgt["last_observed"])
                            )
                        else:
                            cadence_targets.remove(tgt)
                        while_cntr += 1
                        if while_cntr > len(obs_targets):
                            break
                    if done:
                        break
                    user_logger.trace(
                        "TRACE: observer after cadence\n {}".format(observer)
                    )
                    # observe non cadence target
                    if target["cadence"] < 0:
                        user_logger.trace("TRACE: normal target\n {}".format(target))
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: observer before track\n {}".format(observer)
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: ts before observe {}".format(time.time())
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: target last "
                            "observed {}".format(target["last_observed"])
                        )
                        targets_visible += observe(session,
                                                   ref_antenna,
                                                   target,
                                                   **obs_plan_params)
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: observer after track\n {}".format(observer)
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: ts after observe {}".format(time.time())
                        )
                        if targets_visible:
                            target["obs_cntr"] += 1
                            target["last_observed"] = time.time()
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: target observation # {} last observed "
                            "{}".format(target["obs_cntr"], target["last_observed"])
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: observer after track\n {}".format(observer)
                        )
                    # loop continuation checks
                    delta_time = time.time() - session.start_time
                    user_logger.trace("TRACE: time elapsed {} sec".format(delta_time))
                    user_logger.trace(
                        "TRACE: total obs duration {} sec".format(obs_duration)
                    )
                    if obs_duration > 0:
                        time_remaining = obs_duration - delta_time
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: time remaining {} sec".format(time_remaining)
                        )
                        next_target = obs_targets[(tgt_cntr + 1) % len(obs_targets)]
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: next target before cadence "
                            "check:\n{}".format(next_target)
                        )
                        # check if there is a cadence target that must be run
                        # instead of next target
                        for next_cadence_tgt_idx in range(tgt_cntr + 1, len(obs_targets)):
                            next_cadence_target = obs_targets[
                                next_cadence_tgt_idx % len(obs_targets)
                            ]
                            if next_cadence_target["cadence"] > 0:
                                user_logger.trace(
                                    "TRACE: time needed for next obs "
                                    "{} sec".format(next_cadence_target["cadence"])
                                )
                                next_target = obs_targets[
                                    next_cadence_tgt_idx % len(obs_targets)
                                ]
                                continue
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: next target after cadence "
                            "check:\n{}".format(next_target)
                        )
                        user_logger.trace(
                            "TRACE: time needed for next obs "
                            "{} sec".format(next_target["duration"])
                        )
                        if (
                            time_remaining < 1.0
                            or time_remaining < next_target["duration"]
                        ):
                            user_logger.info(
                                "Scheduled observation time lapsed - ending observation"
                            )
                            done = True
                            break
                # during dry-run when sessions exit time is reset so will be incorrect
                # outside the loop
                observation_timer = time.time()
                if obs_duration < 0:
                    user_logger.info("Observation list completed - ending observation")
                    done = True
                # for multiple loop, check start lst of next loop
                if next_start_lst is not None:
                    check_local_lst = observer.sidereal_time()
                    if (check_local_lst > next_start_lst) or (
                        not _next_day(next_start_lst, next_end_lst, check_local_lst)
                    ):
                        user_logger.info("Moving to next LST loop")
                        done = True
                # End if there is nothing to do
                if not targets_visible:
                    user_logger.warning(
                        "No more targets to observe - stopping script "
                        "instead of hanging around"
                    )
                    done = True
    user_logger.trace("TRACE: observer at end\n {}".format(observer))
    # display observation cycle statistics
    # currently only available for single LST range observations
    if nr_obs_loops < 2:
        print
        user_logger.info("Observation loop statistics")
        total_obs_time = observation_timer - session.start_time
        if obs_duration < 0:
            user_logger.info("Single run through observation target list")
        else:
            user_logger.info(
                "Desired observation time {:.2f} sec "
                "({:.2f} min)".format(obs_duration, obs_duration / 60.0)
            )
        user_logger.info(
            "Total observation time {:.2f} sec "
            "({:.2f} min)".format(total_obs_time, total_obs_time / 60.0)
        )
        if len(obs_targets) > 0:
            user_logger.info("Targets observed :")
            for unique_target in np.unique(obs_targets["name"]):
                cntrs = obs_targets[obs_targets["name"] == unique_target]["obs_cntr"]
                durations = obs_targets[obs_targets["name"] == unique_target][
                    "duration"
                ]
                if np.isnan(durations).any():
                    user_logger.info(
                        "{} observed {} times".format(unique_target, np.sum(cntrs))
                    )
                else:
                    user_logger.info(
                        "{} observed for {} sec".format(
                            unique_target, np.sum(cntrs * durations)
                        )
                    )
        print
def main(args):
    """Run the observation.
    Run the observation script read arguments from yaml file
    """
    (opts, args) = astrokat.cli(
        os.path.basename(__file__),
        # remove redundant KAT-7 options
        long_opts_to_remove=[
            "--mode",
            "--dbe-centre-freq",
            "--no-mask",
            "--horizon",
            "--centre-freq",
        ],
        args=args,
    )
    # suppress the sessions noise diode, which is outdated
    # will use it again once functionality corrected
    # TODO: Currently the fire_noise_diode function in mkat_session.py is
    # outdated. This has to be updated to reflect the new noise diode pattern
    # implementation, and this default setting then removed.
    opts.nd_params = "off"
    # astrokat does not support observational command line parameters
    # all observational parameters must be in the YAML file
    # command line arguments will be dropped to unknown arguments
    unknown_args = [arg for arg in args if arg.startswith("--")]
    if any("horizon" in arg for arg in unknown_args):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Command line option {} not supported. "
            "Please specify parameters in YAML file.".format("horizon")
        )
    # TODO: add correlator settings YAML option for config file
    # unpack observation from observation plan
    if opts.yaml:
        opts.obs_plan_params = read_yaml(opts.yaml)
    # ensure sessions has the YAML horizon value if given
    if "horizon" in opts.obs_plan_params:
        opts.horizon = opts.obs_plan_params["horizon"]
    else:
        opts.horizon = 20.0  # deg above horizon default
    # set log level
    if opts.debug:
        user_logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    if opts.trace:
        user_logger.setLevel(logging.TRACE)
    # process the flat list of targets into a structure with sources
    # convert celestial targets coordinates to all be equatorial (ra,dec)
    # horizontal coordinates (alt, az)
    #  for scans, the coordinates will be converted to enable delay tracking
    #  for tracks the coordinates will be left as is with no delay tracking
    # planetary bodies are passed through to katpoint Target as is
    # elliptical solar bodies such as comets are also passed through as katpoint Targets
    for obs_dict in opts.obs_plan_params['observation_loop']:
        start_ts = timestamp2datetime(time.time())
        if "durations" in opts.obs_plan_params:
            obs_time_info = opts.obs_plan_params["durations"]
            if "start_time" in obs_time_info:

# Factory for creating and managing EscapePod intents
__all__ = ['IntentCreator']
from enum import Enum
from typing import List
from . import network, helpers
from .messaging import protocol
from .messages import escapepod_intent
from .exceptions import EscapePodProxyException

class Status(Enum):
    """Defines the status codes for response messages."""
    OK = 0
    ERROR = 1

class IntentCreator(helpers.Component):
    """Manages intent operations and communication with the EscapePod service"""
    
    @network.on_async_thread()
    async def build_intent(self, title: str, examples: str, note: str = None, tag: str = None) -> protocol.InsertIntentResponse:
        """
        Creates a new intent with provided parameters.
        """
        if not title or title.strip() == "":
            raise EscapePodProxyException("Intent title is required")
        if tag is None: 
            tag = f"intent_{title}"
        new_intent = escapepod_intent(name=title, intent=tag, utterance_list=examples, description=note)
        result = await self.submit_intent(new_intent.to_json())
        return result.inserted_oid
    
    @network.on_async_thread()
    async def submit_intent(self, payload: str) -> protocol.InsertIntentResponse:
        """
        Submits an intent JSON payload to the server.
        """
        request = protocol.InsertIntentRequest(intent_data=payload)
        response = await self.grpc_interface.InsertIntent(request)
        if response.response.code == Status.ERROR:
            raise EscapePodProxyException(response.response.message)
        return response
    
    @network.on_async_thread()
    async def fetch_intents(self, query_json: str = '{}') -> List[escapepod_intent]:
        """
        Retrieves intents matching the provided filter.
        """
        request = protocol.SelectIntentRequest(filter_json=query_json)
        response = await self.grpc_interface.SelectIntents(request)
        if response.response.code == Status.ERROR:
            raise EscapePodProxyException(response.response.message)
        return escapepod_intent.from_response(response)
    
    @network.on_async_thread()
    async def remove_intent_by_oid(self, oid: str) -> protocol.DeleteIntentResponse:
        """
        Deletes an intent using its unique identifier.
        """
        request = protocol.DeleteIntentRequest(intent_id=oid)
        response = await self.grpc_interface.DeleteIntent(request)
        if response.response.code == Status.ERROR:
            raise EscapePodProxyException(response.response.message)
        return response
    
    @network.on_async_thread()
    async def remove_intent(self, intent_name: str):
        """
        Deletes all intents matching the given name.
        """
        found_intents = await self.fetch_intents('{"intent": "' + intent_name + '"}')
        for entry in found_intents:
            await self.remove_intent_by_oid(entry.id.oid)

import logging
import yaml
import os
from .exceptions import ConfigFileUnreadableError, ConfigError, DeviceNamesNotUniqueWarning

logger = logging.getLogger('fritzexporter.config')

def load_config(config_path):
    cfg = None
    if config_path:
        try:
            with open(config_path, 'r') as file_handle:
                cfg = yaml.safe_load(file_handle)
        except IOError as err:
            logger.error('Config file specified but could not be read: ' + str(err))
            raise ConfigFileUnreadableError(err)
        logger.info(f'Loaded configuration from {config_path}')
    else:
        if all(var in os.environ for var in ['FRITZ_USERNAME', 'FRITZ_PASSWORD']):
            host = os.getenv('FRITZ_HOSTNAME') if ('FRITZ_HOSTNAME' in os.environ) else 'fritz.box'
            dev_name = os.getenv('FRITZ_NAME') if ('FRITZ_NAME' in os.environ) else 'Fritz!Box'
            port_num = int(os.getenv('FRITZ_PORT')) if ('FRITZ_PORT' in os.environ) else 9787
            user = os.getenv('FRITZ_USERNAME')
            pwd = os.getenv('FRITZ_PASSWORD')
            level = os.getenv('FRITZ_LOG_LEVEL', 'INFO')
            validate_log_level(level)
            cfg = {
                'exporter_port': port_num,
                'log_level': level,
                'devices': [
                    {
                        'name': dev_name,
                        'hostname': host,
                        'username': user,
                        'password': pwd
                    }
                ]
            }
            logger.info('No configuration file provided: using environment variables')
        else:
            logger.critical('No config file specified and required env variables missing!')
            raise ConfigError('No config file specified and required env variables missing!')
    return cfg

def validate_log_level(level):
    if level not in ['DEBUG', 'INFO', 'WARNING', 'ERROR', 'CRITICAL']:
        logger.critical('log_level must be one of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL')
        raise ConfigError('log_level must be one of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL')

def validate_configuration(cfg):  # noqa: C901
    # Validate config object: exporter_port must be 1 <= exporter_port <= 65535 and
    # there must be at least one device with hostname, username and password.
    if cfg:
        if 'log_level' in cfg:
            validate_log_level(cfg['log_level'])
        if 'exporter_port' not in cfg:
            cfg['exporter_port'] = '9787'
        elif int(cfg['exporter_port']) < 1 or int(cfg['exporter_port']) > 65535:
            logger.critical('Invalid listening port specified: must be 1-65535')
            raise ConfigError('Invalid listening port specified: must be 1-65535')
        if 'devices' not in cfg or len(cfg['devices']) == 0:
            logger.critical('No devices found in config. Exiting.')
            raise ConfigError('No devices found in config. Exiting.')
        else:
            if any(
                key not in cfg['devices'][0]
                for key in ['hostname', 'username', 'password']
            ):
                logger.critical('Device specified but either hostname, '
                                'username or password are missing')
                raise ConfigError('Device specified but either hostname, '
                                  'username or password are missing')
            for idx, device in enumerate(cfg['devices']):
                if 'name' not in device or device['name'] == '':
                    logger.info(f'No name specified for {device["hostname"]} '
                                '- setting name to fritz-{idx}')
                    device['name'] = f'fritz-{idx}'
            names_list = [device['name'] for device in cfg['devices']]
            if len(names_list) != len(set(names_list)):
                logger.warning('Device names are not unique')
                raise DeviceNamesNotUniqueWarning('Device names are not unique')
    else:
        logger.critical('No config found.')
        raise ConfigError('No config found.')

from allennlp.training.learning_rate_schedulers import LinearWithWarmup

from transformers import AdamW

def create_vocabulary(training_instances: Iterable[Instance]) -> Vocabulary:
    return Vocabulary.from_instances(training_instances)


def construct_model(vocab: Vocabulary, model_checkpoint_path) -> Model:
    if 'CPT_base' in model_checkpoint_path:
        from model_cpt import ClinicalFindingsClassificationModel
    else:
        from model import ClinicalFindingsClassificationModel
    return ClinicalFindingsClassificationModel(vocab=vocab, model_path=model_checkpoint_path)


def setup_trainer(model, training_dataloader, validation_dataloader, device_id, output_directory, hyperparameters) -> Trainer:
    
    # Parameter grouping for weight decay
    decay_parameters = ["bias", "layer_norm", "layernorm"]
    parameter_groups = [{
            "params": [param for name, param in model.named_parameters() if not any(nd in name.lower() for nd in decay_parameters)],
            "weight_decay": 0.05},
            {
            "params": [param for name, param in model.named_parameters() if any(nd in name.lower() for nd in decay_parameters)],
            "weight_decay": 0.0}]
    
    # Learning rate scheduler configuration
    total_training_steps = len(training_dataloader) // hyperparameters.gradient_accumulation_steps * hyperparameters.epochs
    optimizer = AdamW(parameter_groups, lr=hyperparameters.learning_rate, eps=hyperparameters.epsilon)
    lr_scheduler = LinearWithWarmup(optimizer=optimizer,
                                    num_epochs=hyperparameters.epochs,
                                    num_steps_per_epoch=len(training_dataloader),
                                    warmup_steps=0.15 * total_training_steps)
    
    # Checkpoint setup
    checkpoint_handler = Checkpointer(serialization_dir=output_directory,
                                      num_serialized_models_to_keep=2)
    
    # Trainer initialization
    trainer = GradientDescentTrainer(model=model,
                                     optimizer=optimizer,
                                     data_loader=training_dataloader,
                                     patience=hyperparameters.patience,
                                     validation_metric='+Macro-F1',
                                     validation_data_loader=validation_dataloader,
                                     num_epochs=hyperparameters.epochs,
                                     serialization_dir=output_directory,
                                     cuda_device=device_id if str(device_id) != 'cpu' else -1,
                                     learning_rate_scheduler=lr_scheduler,
                                     num_gradient_accumulation_steps=hyperparameters.gradient_accumulation_steps,
                                     checkpointer=checkpoint_handler,
                                     run_sanity_checks=False)
    
    return trainer


def execute_training_pipeline(hyperparameters):
    output_dir = hyperparameters.model_output_path
    vocab_dir = os.path.join(output_dir, "vocab")
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    dataset_reader = DialogueDatasetReader(transformer_load_path=hyperparameters.transformer_path)
    
    # Load datasets
    train_file_path = hyperparameters.train_dataset
    training_samples = list(dataset_reader.read(train_file_path))
    
    dev_file_path = hyperparameters.dev_dataset
    validation_samples = list(dataset_reader.read(dev_file_path))
    
    # Build vocabulary and save
    vocab = create_vocabulary(training_samples + validation_samples)
    vocab.save_to_files(vocab_dir)
    
    # Device setup
    device = torch.device(hyperparameters.gpu_id if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
    
    # Model initialization
    model = construct_model(vocab, hyperparameters.transformer_path)
    model = model.to(device)
    
    # Data loaders
    train_loader = MultiProcessDataLoader(dataset_reader, train_file_path, 
                                          batch_size=hyperparameters.batch_size, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = MultiProcessDataLoader(dataset_reader, dev_file_path, 
                                        batch_size=hyperparameters.batch_size, shuffle=False)
    
    # Indexing with vocabulary
    train_loader.index_with(vocab)
    val_loader.index_with(vocab)
    
    # Trainer setup and training
    trainer = setup_trainer(model, train_loader, val_loader, device, output_dir, hyperparameters)
    trainer.train()
    return trainer

# Training script for deep learning model using PyTorch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.autograd import Variable
from tqdm import tqdm
import utils

def train_model(model, training_data, validation_data=None, save_path='models',
                learning_rate=1e-04, mini_batch_size=32, validation_batch_size=256, num_epochs=5,
                save_interval=500, load_previous=False, use_gpu=False):
    loss_function = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
    
    # Initialize model and tracking variables
    model.train()
    start_epoch = 1
    highest_accuracy = 0
    cumulative_loss = 0
    
    # Load saved checkpoint if requested
    if load_previous:
        start_epoch, highest_accuracy = utils.load_checkpoint(
            model, save_path, best=True
        )
    
    # Main training loop
    for current_epoch in range(start_epoch, num_epochs + 1):
        # Create data loader and progress bar for current epoch
        batch_loader = utils.get_data_loader(
            training_data, mini_batch_size, cuda=use_gpu
        )
        progress_bar = tqdm(enumerate(batch_loader, 1))
        
        for step_index, (inputs, targets) in progress_bar:
            # Reset gradients before backpropagation
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            
            # Forward pass with GPU support
            x = Variable(inputs).cuda() if use_gpu else Variable(inputs)
            y_true = Variable(targets).cuda() if use_gpu else Variable(targets)
            
            # Compute predictions and loss
            predictions = model(x)
            batch_loss = loss_function(predictions, y_true)
            
            # Backpropagation and optimization
            batch_loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            
            # Update and display training statistics
            cumulative_loss += batch_loss.data[0]
            progress_bar.set_description((
                'epoch: {ep}/{total_ep} | '
                'progress: [{processed}/{total}] ({percent:.0f}%) | '
                'loss: {loss_val:.4}'
            ).format(
                ep=current_epoch,
                total_ep=num_epochs,
                processed=step_index * len(inputs),
                total=len(batch_loader.dataset),
                percent=(100. * step_index / len(batch_loader)),
                loss_val=(batch_loss.data[0] / len(inputs))
            ))
            
            # Periodic checkpointing and validation
            if step_index % save_interval == 0:
                print()
                print()
                print('#############')
                print('# checkpoint!')
                print('#############')
                print()
                
                # Evaluate model performance
                accuracy = utils.validate(
                    model, validation_data or training_data,
                    test_size=validation_batch_size, cuda=use_gpu, verbose=True
                )
                
                # Save best model checkpoint
                is_improvement = accuracy > highest_accuracy
                highest_accuracy = max(accuracy, highest_accuracy)
                utils.save_checkpoint(
                    model, save_path, current_epoch,
                    accuracy, best=is_improvement
                )
                print()

import tensorflow as tf

# Standard deviation for convolutional layer weights
_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV = 0.1

def ResNet18(input_tensor, is_train, options):
    # Extract hyperparameters from options
    weight_decay_param = options.get('lambda', None)
    activation_name = options.get('hidden_activation', 'relu')
    activation_func = get_activation_function(activation_name)
    
    # Initial convolutional layer: 7x7, 64 filters, stride 2
    conv_layer_1 = conv2d(input_tensor, 7, 2, 64, init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param)
    conv_layer_1 = batch_norm(conv_layer_1, is_train)
    conv_layer_1 = activation_func(conv_layer_1)
    
    # Max pooling: 3x3 kernel, stride 2
    pool_layer_1 = max_pool(conv_layer_1, 3, 2)
    
    # Residual groups with increasing feature maps
    res_group_1 = resid_group(pool_layer_1, is_train, 3, 64, 2, downsize_factor=1, 
                              init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                              activation=activation_func)
    res_group_2 = resid_group(res_group_1, is_train, 3, 128, 2, 
                              init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                              activation=activation_func)
    res_group_3 = resid_group(res_group_2, is_train, 3, 256, 2, 
                              init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                              activation=activation_func)
    res_group_4 = resid_group(res_group_3, is_train, 3, 512, 2, 
                              init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                              activation=activation_func)
    
    # Global average pooling
    global_avg_pool = tf.reduce_mean(res_group_4, [1, 2])
    
    # Fully connected output layer (100 classes)
    output_fc = fully_connected(global_avg_pool, 100, init_weights_stddev=0.01, 
                                weight_decay=weight_decay_param)
    return output_fc

def ResNet50(input_tensor, is_train, options):
    # Extract hyperparameters from options
    weight_decay_param = options.get('lambda', None)
    activation_name = options.get('hidden_activation', 'relu')
    activation_func = get_activation_function(activation_name)
    
    # Initial convolutional layer: 7x7, 64 filters, stride 2
    conv_layer_1 = conv2d(input_tensor, 7, 2, 64, init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param)
    conv_layer_1 = batch_norm(conv_layer_1, is_train)
    conv_layer_1 = activation_func(conv_layer_1)
    
    # Max pooling: 3x3 kernel, stride 2
    pool_layer_1 = max_pool(conv_layer_1, 3, 2)
    
    # Bottleneck residual groups
    bottleneck_group_1 = bottleneck_group(pool_layer_1, is_train, 3, 64, 3, downsize_factor=1, 
                                          init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                                          activation=activation_func)
    bottleneck_group_2 = bottleneck_group(bottleneck_group_1, is_train, 3, 128, 4, 
                                          init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                                          activation=activation_func)
    bottleneck_group_3 = bottleneck_group(bottleneck_group_2, is_train, 3, 256, 6, 
                                          init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                                          activation=activation_func)
    bottleneck_group_4 = bottleneck_group(bottleneck_group_3, is_train, 3, 512, 3, 
                                          init_stddev=_CONV_WEIGHT_STD_DEV, weight_decay=weight_decay_param, 
                                          activation=activation_func)
    
    # Global average pooling
    global_avg_pool = tf.reduce_mean(bottleneck_group_4, [1, 2])
    
    # Fully connected output layer (100 classes)
    output_fc = fully_connected(global_avg_pool, 100, init_weights_stddev=0.01, 
                                weight_decay=weight_decay_param)
    return output_fc

def AlexNet(input_tensor, dropout_rate):
    # Define weights with Xavier-like initialization
    weights = {
        'wc1': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([11, 11, 3, 96], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / (11 * 11 * 3)))),
        'wc2': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([5, 5, 96, 256], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / (5 * 5 * 96)))),
        'wc3': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([3, 3, 256, 384], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / (3 * 3 * 256)))),
        'wc4': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([3, 3, 384, 256], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / (3 * 3 * 384)))),
        'wc5': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([3, 3, 256, 256], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / (3 * 3 * 256)))),
        'wf6': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([7 * 7 * 256, 4096], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / (7 * 7 * 256)))),
        'wf7': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([4096, 4096], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / 4096))),
        'wo': tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([4096, 100], stddev=np.sqrt(2. / 4096)))
    }
    
    # Define biases initialized to zero
    biases = {
        'bc1': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(96)),
        'bc2': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(256)),
        'bc3': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(384)),
        'bc4': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(256)),
        'bc5': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(256)),
        'bf6': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(4096)),
        'bf7': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(4096)),
        'bo': tf.Variable(tf.zeros(100))
    }
    
    # First conv block: Conv -> ReLU -> LRN -> Pool (224->55->27)
    conv1 = tf.nn.conv2d(input_tensor, weights['wc1'], strides=[1, 4, 4, 1], padding='SAME')
    conv1 = tf.nn.relu(tf.nn.bias_add(conv1, biases['bc1']))
    lrn1 = tf.nn.local_response_normalization(conv1, depth_radius=5, bias=1.0, alpha=1e-4, beta=0.75)
    pool1 = tf.nn.max_pool(lrn1, ksize=[1, 3, 3, 1], strides=[1, 2, 2, 1], padding='SAME')
    
    # Second conv block: Conv -> ReLU -> LRN -> Pool (27->13)
    conv2 = tf.nn.conv2d(pool1, weights['wc2'], strides=[1, 1, 1, 1], padding='SAME')
    conv2 = tf.nn.relu(tf.nn.bias_add(conv2, biases['bc2']))
    lrn2 = tf.nn.local_response_normalization(conv2, depth_radius=5, bias=1.0, alpha=1e-4, beta=0.75)
    pool2 = tf.nn.max_pool(lrn2, ksize=[1, 3, 3, 1], strides=[1, 2, 2, 1], padding='SAME')
    
    # Third conv block: Conv -> ReLU (13->13)
    conv3 = tf.nn.conv2d(pool2, weights['wc3'], strides=[1, 1, 1, 1], padding='SAME')
    conv3 = tf.nn.relu(tf.nn.bias_add(conv3, biases['bc3']))
    
    # Fourth conv block: Conv -> ReLU (13->13)
    conv4 = tf.nn.conv2d(conv3, weights['wc4'], strides=[1, 1, 1, 1], padding='SAME')
    conv4 = tf.nn.relu(tf.nn.bias_add(conv4, biases['bc4']))
    
    # Fifth conv block: Conv -> ReLU -> Pool (13->6)
    conv5 = tf.nn.conv2d(conv4, weights['wc5'], strides=[1, 1, 1, 1], padding='SAME')
    conv5 = tf.nn.relu(tf.nn.bias_add(conv5, biases['bc5']))
    pool5 = tf.nn.max_pool(conv5, ksize=[1, 3, 3, 1], strides=[1, 2, 2, 1], padding='SAME')
    
    # First fully connected layer: Reshape -> FC -> ReLU -> Dropout
    fc6 = tf.reshape(pool5, [-1, weights['wf6'].get_shape().as_list()[0]])
    fc6 = tf.add(tf.matmul(fc6, weights['wf6']), biases['bf6'])
    fc6 = tf.nn.relu(fc6)
    fc6 = tf.nn.dropout(fc6, dropout_rate)
    
    # Second fully connected layer: FC -> ReLU -> Dropout
    fc7 = tf.add(tf.matmul(fc6, weights['wf7']), biases['bf7'])
    fc7 = tf.nn.relu(fc7)
    fc7 = tf.nn.dropout(fc7, dropout_rate)
    
    # Output layer: FC
    final_output = tf.add(tf.matmul(fc7, weights['wo']), biases['bo'])
    return final_output

from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class OrgAddress(object):
    street1: str
    street2: str
    location: str
    region: str
    zipCode: str
    nation: str
    _reserved_fields: dict  # reserved for future use and should remain empty
    
    @staticmethod
    def from_mapping(source: dict):
        source = dict(source)  # avoid modifying the input dictionary
        street1 = source.pop('addressLine1')
        street2 = source.pop('addressLine2')
        location = source.pop('city')
        region = source.pop('state')
        zipCode = source.pop('postalCode')
        nation = source.pop('country')
        return OrgAddress(
            street1=street1,
            street2=street2,
            location=location,
            region=region,
            zipCode=zipCode,
            nation=nation,
            _reserved_fields=source,
        )

import itertools
import operator
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def extract_value(field, converter=float):
    # Extract numeric value from field string like "value=123.45)"
    _, val_part = field[:-1].split("=")
    return converter(val_part)

def load_results(base_dir):
    for res_file in sorted(base_dir.iterdir()):
        job_id = res_file.name
        summary_path = res_file / "result.txt"
        
        if not summary_path.exists():
            print(f"Skipping {job_id}: missing result file")
            continue
            
        with open(summary_path) as fh:
            header_line = fh.readline()
            parts = header_line.split()
            
            # Unpack known fields from the summary line
            (
                _,
                total_txns,
                aborts,
                duration,
                wait_time,
                ts_alloc_time,
                man_time,
                idx_time,
                abort_handling,
                cleanup_time,
                avg_latency,
                deadlocks,
                cycle_check,
                dl_check_duration,
                dl_wait_duration,
                query_time,
                *_,
            ) = parts
            
            # Parse job metadata
            workload_type, algo, index_algo, thread_count, rw_ratio_str = job_id.split(",")
            
            # Yield parsed data tuple
            yield (
                workload_type,
                algo,
                index_algo,
                int(thread_count),
                extract_value(total_txns) / extract_value(idx_time),
                rw_ratio_str
            )

def generate_plot(results_directory):
    # Collect and sort all results
    all_data = sorted(load_results(results_directory))
    
    # Group by (workload, algorithm, index type)
    grouped_data = {
        group_key: list(group_items)
        for group_key, group_items in itertools.groupby(
            all_data, key=lambda x: x[:3]
        )
    }
    
    # Create figure with specified size
    plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
    
    # Define subplot positions based on index and workload
    subplot_map = {
        ("IDX_HASH", "TPCC"): 1,
        ("IDX_BTREE", "TPCC"): 2,
        ("IDX_HASH", "YCSB"): 3,
        ("IDX_BTREE", "YCSB"): 4,
    }
    
    # Plot each group
    for idx, (key, items) in enumerate(grouped_data.items()):
        workload_name, algorithm_name, index_name = key
        
        # Extract data series
        read_write_ratios = [entry[5] for entry in items]
        throughput_values = [entry[4] for entry in items]
        
        # Build label for legend
        plot_label = " ".join(key)
        
        # Select appropriate subplot
        subplot_pos = subplot_map[(index_name, workload_name)]
        plt.subplot(2, 2, subplot_pos)
        
        # Plot data points
        plt.plot(read_write_ratios, throughput_values, 
                 label=algorithm_name, marker='o')
        
        # Configure axes and labels
        plt.xlabel("Read/Write Ratio")
        plt.ylabel("Throughput (txn/sec)")
        plt.legend()
        plt.title(f"{workload_name} {index_name}")
    
    # Save final plot
    output_path = results_directory / "4_6_rw_ratio_plot.png"
    plt.savefig(output_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    base_dir = Path("4_6_results")
    generate_plot(base_dir)

# CRR Agent Implementation with modified naming and structure
import copy
from typing import Dict, Iterator, List, NamedTuple, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
import acme
import chex
import haiku as hk
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax
import reverb
import rlax
from acme import types
from acme.jax import networks as networks_lib
from acme.utils import counting, loggers

class ModelState(NamedTuple):
    """Model state for CRR agent."""
    actor_params: hk.Params
    qfunction_params: hk.Params
    actor_opt_state: hk.Params
    qfunction_opt_state: hk.Params
    actor_target_params: hk.Params
    qfunction_target_params: hk.Params
    updates: int
    rng_key: networks_lib.PRNGKey

class CRRAgent(acme.Learner):
    """CRR Agent component."""
    _model_state: ModelState
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        actor_network: networks_lib.FeedForwardNetwork,
        qfunction_network: networks_lib.FeedForwardNetwork,
        replay_iterator: Iterator[reverb.ReplaySample],
        key_generator: jnp.ndarray,
        actor_optimizer: Optional[optax.GradientTransformation] = None,
        qfunction_optimizer: Optional[optax.GradientTransformation] = None,
        discount_factor: float = 0.99,
        target_update_frequency: int = 100,
        num_samples_td: int = 1,
        num_samples_policy: int = 4,
        value_aggregation: str = "mean",
        policy_mode: str = "exp",
        importance_ratio_limit: float = 20.0,
        temperature: float = 1.0,
        counter_module: Optional[counting.Counter] = None,
        logger_module: Optional[loggers.Logger] = None,
    ):
        if policy_mode not in {"exp", "binary", "all"}:
            raise ValueError(
                "policy_mode must be one of ['exp', 'binary', 'all'], "
                f"got {policy_mode}"
            )
        if value_aggregation not in {"mean", "max", "min"}:
            raise ValueError(
                "value_aggregation must be one of ['mean', 'max', 'min'], "
                f"got {value_aggregation}"
            )
        if actor_optimizer is None:
            actor_optimizer = optax.chain(
                optax.clip_by_global_norm(40.0),
                optax.adam(1e-4),
            )
        if qfunction_optimizer is None:
            qfunction_optimizer = optax.chain(
                optax.clip_by_global_norm(40.0),
                optax.adam(1e-4),
            )

        def compute_expected_value(logits, support_atoms):
            """Compute expected value from distributional Q-function"""
            chex.assert_rank(logits, 2)
            chex.assert_rank(support_atoms, 1)
            probs = jax.nn.softmax(logits)
            return jnp.sum(probs * support_atoms, axis=-1)

        def objective_fn(
            online_weights: Tuple[networks_lib.Params, networks_lib.Params],
            target_weights: Tuple[networks_lib.Params, networks_lib.Params],
            sample_batch: types.Transition,
            rng_key: networks_lib.PRNGKey,
        ):
            """Loss function for CRR."""
            action_key1, action_key2 = jax.random.split(rng_key)
            experience: types.Transition = sample_batch.data
            actor_weights, qfunction_weights = online_weights
            actor_target_weights, qfunction_target_weights = target_weights
            
            obs_prev = experience.observation
            action_prev = experience.action
            reward_curr = experience.reward
            discount_curr = discount_factor * experience.discount
            obs_curr = experience.next_observation
            
            # ========================= Q-function learning =============================
            q_logits_prev, q_atoms_prev = qfunction_network.apply(
                qfunction_weights, obs_prev, action_prev
            )
            
            next_action_dist = actor_network.apply(actor_target_weights, obs_curr)
            sampled_actions_next = next_action_dist.sample(
                num_samples_td, seed=action_key1
            )
            
            # [N, B, ...]
            sampled_q_logits, sampled_q_atoms = jax.vmap(
                qfunction_network.apply, (None, None, 0)
            )(qfunction_target_weights, obs_curr, sampled_actions_next)
            
            sampled_logprobs = jax.nn.log_softmax(sampled_q_logits, axis=-1)
            q_logits_next = jax.scipy.special.logsumexp(sampled_logprobs, axis=0)
            q_atoms_next = sampled_q_atoms[0]
            
            batch_td = jax.vmap(
                rlax.categorical_td_learning, in_axes=(None, 0, 0, 0, None, 0)
            )
            
            qfunction_loss_t = batch_td(
                q_atoms_prev, q_logits_prev, reward_curr, discount_curr, q_atoms_next, q_logits_next
            )
            chex.assert_rank(qfunction_loss_t, 1)
            qfunction_loss_t = jnp.mean(qfunction_loss_t)
            
            # ========================= Actor learning =============================
            action_dist_prev = actor_network.apply(actor_weights, obs_prev)
            q_prev_mean = compute_expected_value(q_logits_prev, q_atoms_prev)
            
            sampled_actions_prev = action_dist_prev.sample(
                num_samples_policy, seed=action_key2
            )
            
            tiled_q_logits, tiled_q_values = jax.vmap(
                qfunction_network.apply, (None, None, 0)
            )(qfunction_weights, obs_prev, sampled_actions_prev)
            tiled_v_values = jax.vmap(compute_expected_value)(tiled_q_logits, tiled_q_values)
            
            if value_aggregation == "mean":
                v_estimate = jnp.mean(tiled_v_values, axis=0)
            elif value_aggregation == "max":
                v_estimate = jnp.max(tiled_v_values, axis=0)
            elif value_aggregation == "min":
                v_estimate = jnp.min(tiled_v_values, axis=0)
                
            assert len(action_dist_prev.batch_shape) == 1
            actor_loss_batch = -action_dist_prev.log_prob(action_prev)
            advantage = q_prev_mean - v_estimate
            
            if policy_mode == "exp":
                actor_loss_weight = jnp.minimum(
                    jnp.exp(advantage / temperature), importance_ratio_limit
                )
            elif policy_mode == "binary":
                actor_loss_weight = (advantage > 0).astype(reward_curr.dtype)
            elif policy_mode == "all":
                actor_loss_weight = 1.0
                
            actor_loss_weight = jax.lax.stop_gradient(actor_loss_weight)
            actor_loss_batch *= actor_loss_weight
            chex.assert_rank(actor_loss_batch, 1)
            actor_loss_t = jnp.mean(actor_loss_batch)
            avg_actor_weight = jnp.mean(actor_loss_weight)
            
            qfunction_loss = qfunction_loss_t
            actor_loss = actor_loss_t
            total_loss = qfunction_loss + actor_loss
            
            metrics = {
                "actor_loss": actor_loss,
                "qfunction_loss": qfunction_loss,
                "actor_loss_weight": avg_actor_weight,
                "advantage_estimate": jnp.mean(advantage),
                "q_value": jnp.mean(q_prev_mean),
            }
            return total_loss, metrics

        def sgd_update(
            state: ModelState,
            batch: reverb.ReplaySample,
        ) -> Tuple[ModelState, Dict[str, types.NestedArray]]:
            """Perform a single SGD update."""
            online_weights = (state.actor_params, state.qfunction_params)
            target_weights = (state.actor_target_params, state.qfunction_target_params)
            step_key, rng_key = jax.random.split(state.rng_key)
            (actor_grads, qfunction_grads), metrics = jax.grad(objective_fn, has_aux=True)(
                online_weights, target_weights, batch, step_key
            )
            metrics.update(
                {
                    "actor_g_norm": optax.global_norm(actor_grads),
                    "qfunction_g_norm": optax.global_norm(qfunction_grads),
                }
            )
            
            actor_updates, new_actor_opt_state = actor_optimizer.update(
                actor_grads, state.actor_opt_state
            )
            qfunction_updates, new_qfunction_opt_state = qfunction_optimizer.update(
                qfunction_grads, state.qfunction_opt_state
            )
            
            new_qfunction_weights = optax.apply_updates(state.qfunction_params, qfunction_updates)
            new_actor_weights = optax.apply_updates(state.actor_params, actor_updates)
            
            new_actor_target_weights, new_qfunction_target_weights = optax.periodic_update(
                (new_actor_weights, new_qfunction_weights),
                target_weights,
                steps=state.updates,
                update_period=target_update_frequency,
            )
            
            new_state = state._replace(
                updates=state.updates + 1,
                rng_key=rng_key,
                qfunction_params=new_qfunction_weights,
                actor_params=new_actor_weights,
                actor_target_params=new_actor_target_weights,
                qfunction_target_params=new_qfunction_target_weights,
                qfunction_opt_state=new_qfunction_opt_state,
                actor_opt_state=new_actor_opt_state,
            )
            return new_state, metrics

        def initialize_state(key):
            actor_init_key, qfunction_init_key, rng_key = jax.random.split(key, 3)
            initial_actor_weights = actor_network.init(actor_init_key)
            initial_actor_opt_state = actor_optimizer.init(initial_actor_weights)
            initial_qfunction_weights = qfunction_network.init(qfunction_init_key)
            initial_qfunction_opt_state = qfunction_optimizer.init(initial_qfunction_weights)
            
            return ModelState(
                updates=0,
                rng_key=rng_key,
                actor_params=initial_actor_weights,
                qfunction_params=initial_qfunction_weights,
                actor_opt_state=initial_actor_opt_state,
                qfunction_opt_state=initial_qfunction_opt_state,
                actor_target_params=copy.deepcopy(initial_actor_weights),
                qfunction_target_params=copy.deepcopy(initial_qfunction_weights),
            )

        self._sgd_update = jax.jit(sgd_update)
        self._data_stream = replay_iterator
        self._model_state = initialize_state(key_generator)
        
        self._logger = logger_module or loggers.make_default_logger("agent", save_data=False)
        self._counter = counter_module or counting.Counter()

    def update(self):
        # Sample from replay buffer
        batch = next(self._data_stream)
        self._model_state, metrics = self._sgd_update(self._model_state, batch)
        counts = self._counter.increment(steps=1)
        metrics.update(counts)
        self._logger.write(metrics)

    def get_parameters(self, names: Sequence[str]) -> List[networks_lib.Params]:
        parameters = {
            "actor": self._model_state.actor_params,
            "qfunction": self._model_state.qfunction_params,
        }
        return [parameters[name] for name in names]

    def checkpoint(self) -> ModelState:
        return self._model_state

    def load_checkpoint(self, state: ModelState):
        self._model_state = state

import math
from contextlib import contextmanager
from importlib import import_module
from typing import Dict, List
import torch
import yaml

class ConfigurationHandler:
    def __init__(self, settings: Dict):
        self.settings = settings
    
    def instantiate(self, key: str, *args, **kwargs) -> object:
        # Base module path
        base = "src"
        target_path = self.settings[key]
        if target_path is None:
            return None
        
        module_part, class_part = target_path.rsplit(".", 1)
        module = import_module(f"{base}.{module_part}")
        
        param_dict = self.settings.get(f"{key}_params", {}) or {}
        merged_kwargs = {**kwargs, **param_dict}
        
        return getattr(module, class_part)(*args, **merged_kwargs)
    
    def instantiate_multiple(self, key: str, *args, **kwargs) -> List[object]:
        # Base module path
        base = "src"
        instances = []
        target_paths = self.settings[key]
        n_items = len(target_paths)
        
        param_lists = self.settings.get(f"{key}_params", []) or [{}] * n_items
        
        # Normalize single arguments to lists
        normalized_args = [
            arg if isinstance(arg, list) else [arg] * n_items for arg in args
        ]
        # Transpose to group per instance
        arg_groups = list(zip(*normalized_args))
        
        for path, params, group in zip(target_paths, param_lists, arg_groups):
            mod_name, cls_name = path.rsplit(".", 1)
            mod = import_module(f"{base}.{mod_name}")
            instances.append(getattr(mod, cls_name)(*group, **params))
        
        return instances

def load_yaml_config(filepath):
    with open(filepath, "r") as stream:
        try:
            data = yaml.safe_load(stream)
        except yaml.YAMLError as error:
            print(error)
    return data

def log_mean_exponential(tensor, axis=0, keepdims=False):
    return torch.logsumexp(tensor, axis, keepdim=keepdims) - math.log(tensor.size(axis))

'''
Simplified grammar producing a fixed hierarchical structure:
ROOT -> UNOBSERVED INTERMEDIATE NODE -> OBSERVABLE TERMINAL NODE
Both intermediate and terminal nodes are positioned along the world frame normal axis,
with identical orientation but different positions.
'''

# Small tolerance value to avoid planar degeneracy
tol = 1E-4

## Terminal object node (visible)
class TerminalObject(TerminalNode):
    def __init__(self, transform):
        geom_info = PhysicsGeometryInfo()
        geom_info.register_geometry(
            tf=drake_tf_to_torch_tf(RigidTransform(p=[0., 0., 0.07])),
            geometry=pydrake_geom.Box(0.12, 0.12, 0.12),
            color=np.array([0.9, 0.6, 0.3, 1.0])
        )
        super().__init__(
            tf=transform,
            physics_geometry_info=geom_info,
            observed=True
        )

## Hidden intermediate node (unobservable)
class LatentNode(AndNode):
    def __init__(self, transform):
        super().__init__(
            tf=transform,
            physics_geometry_info=None,
            observed=False
        )
    
    @classmethod
    def create_rules(cls):
        return [
            ProductionRule(
                child_type=TerminalObject,
                xyz_rule=WorldFrameGaussianOffsetRule(
                    mean=torch.zeros(3),
                    variance=torch.tensor([1.5, 2.5, tol])
                ),
                rotation_rule=SameRotationRule() 
            )
        ]

## Root node (visible base)
class BaseNode(AndNode):
    def __init__(self, transform):
        geom_info = PhysicsGeometryInfo()
        geom_info.register_geometry(
            tf=drake_tf_to_torch_tf(RigidTransform(p=[0., 0., -0.08])),
            geometry=pydrake_geom.Box(0.15, 0.15, 0.15),
            color=np.array([0.25, 0.6, 0.95, 1.0])
        )
        super().__init__(
            tf=transform,
            physics_geometry_info=geom_info,
            observed=True
        )
    
    @classmethod
    def create_rules(cls):
        return [
            ProductionRule(
                child_type=LatentNode,
                xyz_rule=WorldFrameGaussianOffsetRule(
                    mean=torch.zeros(3),
                    variance=torch.tensor([1.5, 2.5, tol])
                ),
                rotation_rule=SameRotationRule()
            )
        ]
