def build_dpt_configuration(model_identifier):
    base_hidden_dim = 768
    num_layers = 12
    num_heads = 12
    ff_intermediate_size = 3072
    feature_levels = ["stage3", "stage6", "stage9", "stage12"]  # corresponds to [2,5,8,11] in original BEiT-base-384

    if "large" in model_identifier:
        base_hidden_dim = 1024
        num_layers = 24
        num_heads = 16
        ff_intermediate_size = 4096
        feature_levels = ["stage6", "stage12", "stage18", "stage24"]  # for beit-large-512: [5,11,17,23]

    if "512" in model_identifier:
        input_resolution = 512
    elif "384" in model_identifier:
        input_resolution = 384
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported model configuration")

    backbone_settings = BeitConfig(
        image_size=input_resolution,
        num_hidden_layers=num_layers,
        hidden_size=base_hidden_dim,
        intermediate_size=ff_intermediate_size,
        num_attention_heads=num_heads,
        use_relative_position_bias=True,
        reshape_hidden_states=False,
        out_features=feature_levels,
    )

    neck_channels = [256, 512, 1024, 1024] if "large" in model_identifier else [96, 192, 384, 768]
    full_config = DPTConfig(backbone_config=backbone_settings, neck_hidden_sizes=neck_channels)
    return full_config, input_resolution


def generate_key_mapping(config):
    key_replacements = []
    # stem mapping
    key_replacements.append(("pretrained.model.cls_token", "backbone.embeddings.cls_token"))
    key_replacements.append(("pretrained.model.patch_embed.proj.weight", "backbone.embeddings.patch_embeddings.projection.weight"))
    key_replacements.append(("pretrained.model.patch_embed.proj.bias", "backbone.embeddings.patch_embeddings.projection.bias"))

    # transformer encoder layers
    for idx in range(config.backbone_config.num_hidden_layers):
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.gamma_1", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.lambda_1"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.gamma_2", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.lambda_2"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.norm1.weight", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.layernorm_before.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.norm1.bias", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.layernorm_before.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.norm2.weight", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.layernorm_after.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.norm2.bias", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.layernorm_after.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.mlp.fc1.weight", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.intermediate.dense.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.mlp.fc1.bias", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.intermediate.dense.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.mlp.fc2.weight", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.output.dense.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.mlp.fc2.bias", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.output.dense.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.attn.proj.weight", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.attention.output.dense.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.attn.proj.bias", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.attention.output.dense.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.attn.relative_position_bias_table", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.attention.attention.relative_position_bias.relative_position_bias_table"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.model.blocks.{idx}.attn.relative_position_index", f"backbone.encoder.layer.{idx}.attention.attention.relative_position_bias.relative_position_index"))

    # readout projections & resize blocks
    for stage_idx in range(4):
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.act_postprocess{stage_idx+1}.0.project.0.weight", f"neck.reassemble_stage.readout_projects.{stage_idx}.0.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.act_postprocess{stage_idx+1}.0.project.0.bias", f"neck.reassemble_stage.readout_projects.{stage_idx}.0.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.act_postprocess{stage_idx+1}.3.weight", f"neck.reassemble_stage.layers.{stage_idx}.projection.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.act_postprocess{stage_idx+1}.3.bias", f"neck.reassemble_stage.layers.{stage_idx}.projection.bias"))
        if stage_idx != 2:
            key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.act_postprocess{stage_idx+1}.4.weight", f"neck.reassemble_stage.layers.{stage_idx}.resize.weight"))
            key_replacements.append((f"pretrained.act_postprocess{stage_idx+1}.4.bias", f"neck.reassemble_stage.layers.{stage_idx}.resize.bias"))

    # refinenet mapping (reversed order)
    reverse_map = {1:3, 2:2, 3:1, 4:0}
    for i in range(1, 5):
        j = reverse_map[i]
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.out_conv.weight", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.projection.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.out_conv.bias", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.projection.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit1.conv1.weight", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer1.convolution1.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit1.conv1.bias", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer1.convolution1.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit1.conv2.weight", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer1.convolution2.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit1.conv2.bias", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer1.convolution2.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit2.conv1.weight", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer2.convolution1.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit2.conv1.bias", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer2.convolution1.bias"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit2.conv2.weight", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer2.convolution2.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.refinenet{i}.resConfUnit2.conv2.bias", f"neck.fusion_stage.layers.{j}.residual_layer2.convolution2.bias"))

    # scratch convolutions
    for stage in range(4):
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.layer{stage+1}_rn.weight", f"neck.convs.{stage}.weight"))

    # head layers
    for layer_num in range(0, 5, 2):
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.output_conv.{layer_num}.weight", f"head.head.{layer_num}.weight"))
        key_replacements.append((f"scratch.output_conv.{layer_num}.bias", f"head.head.{layer_num}.bias"))

    return key_replacements


def filter_unnecessary_keys(state_dict):
    skip_list = ["pretrained.model.cls_token", "pretrained.model.patch_embed.proj.weight", "pretrained.model.patch_embed.proj.bias",
                 "pretrained.model.fc_norm.weight", "pretrained.model.fc_norm.bias"]
    for key in skip_list:
        state_dict.pop(key, None)


def decompose_qkv_weights(state_dict, config):
    embed_dim = config.backbone_config.hidden_size
    for layer_idx in range(config.backbone_config.num_hidden_layers):
        combined_weight = state_dict.pop(f"pretrained.model.blocks.{layer_idx}.attn.qkv.weight")
        q_bias_term = state_dict.pop(f"pretrained.model.blocks.{layer_idx}.attn.q_bias")
        v_bias_term = state_dict.pop(f"pretrained.model.blocks.{layer_idx}.attn.v_bias")

        q_part = combined_weight[:embed_dim, :]
        k_part = combined_weight[embed_dim : embed_dim * 2, :]
        v_part = combined_weight[-embed_dim:, :]

        state_dict[f"backbone.encoder.layer.{layer_idx}.attention.attention.query.weight"] = q_part
        state_dict[f"backbone.encoder.layer.{layer_idx}.attention.attention.query.bias"] = q_bias_term
        state_dict[f"backbone.encoder.layer.{layer_idx}.attention.attention.key.weight"] = k_part
        state_dict[f"backbone.encoder.layer.{layer_idx}.attention.attention.value.weight"] = v_part
        state_dict[f"backbone.encoder.layer.{layer_idx}.attention.attention.value.bias"] = v_bias_term


def update_key_name(dictionary, old_key, new_key):
    value = dictionary.pop(old_key)
    dictionary[new_key] = value


def fetch_sample_image():
    image_url = "http://images.cocodataset.org/val2017/000000039769.jpg"
    raw_data = req_lib.get(image_url, stream=True).raw
    return Image.open(raw_data)


@torch.no_grad()
def execute_conversion(model_name, output_dir, upload_to_hub):
    supported_models = {
        "dpt-beit-large-512": "https://github.com/isl-org/MiDaS/releases/download/v3_1/dpt_beit_large_512.pt",
        "dpt-beit-large-384": "https://github.com/isl-org/MiDaS/releases/download/v3_1/dpt_beit_large_384.pt",
        "dpt-beit-base-384": "https://github.com/isl-org/MiDaS/releases/download/v3_1/dpt_beit_base_384.pt",
    }

    checkpoint_url = supported_models[model_name]
    config, resolution = build_dpt_configuration(model_name)

    original_weights = torch.hub.load_state_dict_from_url(checkpoint_url, map_location="cpu")
    filter_unnecessary_keys(original_weights)

    mappings = generate_key_mapping(config)
    for src, dst in mappings:
        update_key_name(original_weights, src, dst)

    decompose_qkv_weights(original_weights, config)

    hf_model = DPTForDepthEstimation(config)
    missing, extra = hf_model.load_state_dict(original_weights, strict=False)
    print("Missing keys:", missing)
    print("Unexpected keys:", extra)
    assert not missing, "All weights should be loaded"

    hf_model.eval()

    processor = DPTImageProcessor(
        size={"height": resolution, "width": resolution}, keep_aspect_ratio=False, ensure_multiple_of=32
    )
    sample_image = fetch_sample_image()
    inputs = processor(sample_image, return_tensors="pt").pixel_values

    print("First values of pixel values:", inputs[0, 0, :3, :3])
    print("Mean of pixel values:", inputs.mean().item())
    print("Shape of pixel values:", inputs.shape)

    # Alternative preprocessing using torchvision
    transforms_module = __import__('torchvision.transforms', fromlist=['Compose', 'Resize', 'ToTensor'])
    transform_ops = transforms_module.Compose([
        transforms_module.Resize((resolution, resolution)),
        transforms_module.ToTensor(),
    ])
    processed_inputs = transform_ops(sample_image).unsqueeze(0)

    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs = hf_model(processed_inputs)
    depth_prediction = outputs.predicted_depth
    print("Shape of predicted depth:", depth_prediction.shape)
    print("First values of predicted depth:", depth_prediction[0, :3, :3])

    # Expected validation slices
    expected_shapes_and_slices = {
        "dpt-beit-large-512": (torch.Size([1, 512, 512]),
                               torch.tensor([[2804.6260, 2792.5708, 2812.9263],
                                             [2772.0288, 2780.1118, 2796.2529],
                                             [2748.1094, 2766.6558, 2766.9834]])),
        "dpt-beit-large-384": (torch.Size([1, 384, 384]),
                               torch.tensor([[1783.2273, 1780.5729, 1792.6453],
                                             [1759.9817, 1765.5359, 1778.5002],
                                             [1739.1633, 1754.7903, 1757.1990]])),
        "dpt-beit-base-384": (torch.Size([1, 384, 384]),
                              torch.tensor([[2898.4482, 2891.3750, 2904.8079],
                                            [2858.6685, 2877.2615, 2894.4507],
                                            [2842.1235, 2854.1023, 2861.6328]]))
    }

    shape, slice_ref = expected_shapes_and_slices[model_name]
    assert depth_prediction.shape == shape
    assert torch.allclose(depth_prediction[0, :3, :3], slice_ref, atol=1e-4)
    print("Looks ok!")

    if output_dir is not None:
        Path(output_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        print(f"Saving model and processor to {output_dir}")
        hf_model.save_pretrained(output_dir)
        processor.save_pretrained(output_dir)

    if upload_to_hub:
        print("Pushing model and processor to hub...")
        hf_model.push_to_hub(repo_id=f"nielsr/{model_name}")
        processor.push_to_hub(repo_id=f"nielsr/{model_name}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert MiDaS models to HuggingFace DPT format.")
    parser.add_argument("--model_name", default="dpt-beit-large-512",
                        choices=["dpt-beit-large-512", "dpt-beit-large-384", "dpt-beit-base-384"],
                        help="Target model name for conversion.")
    parser.add_argument("--pytorch_dump_folder_path", default=None,
                        type=str, help="Directory path to save converted model files.")
    parser.add_argument("--push_to_hub", action="store_true",
                        help="Upload converted model to HuggingFace Hub.")

    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    execute_conversion(arguments.model_name, arguments.pytorch_dump_folder_path, arguments.push_to_hub)

# Custom CUDA extension setup for fake int4 quantization
import os
import torch
from setuptools import setup
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import BuildExtension, CUDAExtension

# Determine target GPU architectures
gpu_archs = []

if torch.cuda.is_available():
    # Collect compute capabilities of all available GPUs
    device_count = torch.cuda.device_count()
    for idx in range(device_count):
        major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(idx)
        gpu_archs.append(f"{major}.{minor}")
    
    # Deduplicate and sort architectures
    gpu_archs = sorted(set(gpu_archs))

# Fallback logic when no GPU is detected or arch list is empty
if not gpu_archs:
    env_var = os.environ.get("TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST", "")
    if env_var:
        # Parse environment variable (supports format like "7.0;7.5;8.0+PTX")
        parsed_archs = []
        for item in env_var.replace(";", " ").split():
            clean_item = item.strip()
            if clean_item:
                # Remove '+PTX' suffix if present
                clean_item = clean_item.replace("+PTX", "")
                parsed_archs.append(clean_item)
        gpu_archs = parsed_archs
    else:
        # Default to widely supported architectures
        gpu_archs = ["8.0", "8.6", "8.9", "9.0"]

# Setup configuration
setup(
    name="fake_int4_quant_cuda",
    ext_modules=[
        CUDAExtension(
            name="fake_int4_quant_cuda",
            sources=["fake_int4_quant_cuda.cu"],
            extra_compile_args={
                "cxx": [
                    "-O3",
                    "-std=c++17",
                ],
                "nvcc": [
                    "-O3",
                    "-std=c++17",
                    "--expt-relaxed-constexpr",
                    "-Xcompiler",
                    "-fPIC",
                ] + [
                    f'-gencode=arch=compute_{arch.replace(".", "")},code=sm_{arch.replace(".", "")}'
                    for arch in gpu_archs
                ] + ["-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a"],
            },
        )
    ],
    cmdclass={"build_ext": BuildExtension},
)

import torch
import mindspeed.megatron_adaptor
import torch.distributed as dist
from megatron.core import mpu
from megatron.training.checkpointing import load_checkpoint
from megatron.training.initialize import initialize_megatron
from megatron.training import get_args
from mindspeed_mm.configs.config import merge_mm_args, mm_extra_args_provider
from mindspeed_mm.arguments import extra_args_provider_decorator
from mindspeed_mm.tasks.inference.pipeline import sora_pipeline_dict
from mindspeed_mm.tasks.inference.pipeline.utils.sora_utils import (
    save_videos,
    save_video_grid,
    load_prompts,
    load_images,
    load_conditional_pixel_values,
    load_videos,
)
from mindspeed_mm.models.predictor import PredictModel
from mindspeed_mm.models.diffusion import DiffusionModel
from mindspeed_mm.models.ae import AEModel
from mindspeed_mm.models.text_encoder import TextEncoder, Tokenizer
from mindspeed_mm.utils.utils import get_dtype, get_device, is_npu_available

if is_npu_available():
    import torch_npu
    from torch_npu.contrib import transfer_to_npu
    torch.npu.config.allow_internal_format = False


def build_inference_pipeline(model_cfg, device):
    base_args = get_args()
    model_cfg.pipeline_config.seed = base_args.seed

    vae_model = AEModel(model_cfg.ae).get_model().to(device, model_cfg.ae.dtype).eval()
    text_enc_model = TextEncoder(model_cfg.text_encoder).get_model().to(device).eval()
    pred_model = PredictModel(model_cfg.predictor).get_model()

    if base_args.load is not None:
        load_checkpoint([pred_model], None, None, strict=False)

    pred_model = pred_model.to(device, model_cfg.predictor.dtype).eval()
    diffusion_scheduler = DiffusionModel(model_cfg.diffusion).get_model()
    tokenizer_obj = Tokenizer(model_cfg.tokenizer).get_tokenizer()

    # Ensure VAE has dtype attribute
    if not hasattr(vae_model, 'dtype'):
        vae_model.dtype = model_cfg.ae.dtype

    pipeline_cls = sora_pipeline_dict[model_cfg.pipeline_class]
    return pipeline_cls(
        vae=vae_model,
        text_encoder=text_enc_model,
        tokenizer=tokenizer_obj,
        scheduler=diffusion_scheduler,
        predict_model=pred_model,
        config=model_cfg.pipeline_config
    )


def _prepare_batch_data(data_list, start_idx, batch_size):
    """Helper to extract a batch from list-like data."""
    return data_list[start_idx:start_idx + batch_size]


def _broadcast_or_gather_video_grids(video_tensor, world_size, rank, device):
    gathered = []
    active_ranks = list(range(world_size))

    if video_tensor.shape[0] < world_size:
        active_ranks = list(range(video_tensor.shape[0]))

    active_ranks = [
        r * mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size() * mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
        for r in active_ranks
    ]

    dist.barrier()

    if rank == 0:
        for src_rank in active_ranks:
            if src_rank != 0:
                shape_buf = torch.empty(5, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
                dist.recv(shape_buf, src=src_rank)
                shape = shape_buf.tolist()
                recv_buf = torch.empty(shape, dtype=video_tensor.dtype, device=device)
                dist.recv(recv_buf, src=src_rank)
                gathered.append(recv_buf.cpu())
            else:
                gathered.append(video_tensor.cpu())
    elif rank in active_ranks:
        shape_tensor = torch.tensor(video_tensor.shape, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        dist.send(shape_tensor, dst=0)
        dist.send(video_tensor, dst=0)

    dist.barrier()
    return torch.cat(gathered, dim=0) if rank == 0 else None


def run_inference():
    # Initialize Megatron environment
    initialize_megatron(
        extra_args_provider=extra_args_provider_decorator(mm_extra_args_provider),
        args_defaults={}
    )
    cfg = get_args()
    merge_mm_args(cfg)

    # Set default for distributed training flag
    cfg.dist_train = getattr(cfg, "dist_train", False)

    # Map micro_batch_size to model config
    cfg.mm.model.micro_batch_size = cfg.micro_batch_size
    model_args = cfg.mm.model

    # Setup inference context
    torch.set_grad_enabled(False)
    target_dtype = get_dtype(model_args.dtype)
    target_device = get_device(model_args.device)

    # Load inputs
    prompt_list = load_prompts(model_args.prompt)
    dual_image_mode = getattr(model_args, "dual_image", False)
    image_list = load_images(model_args.image, dual_image_mode) if hasattr(model_args, "image") else None

    # Expand prompts/images/videos per sample if needed
    num_samples_per_prompt = getattr(model_args, "num_inference_videos_per_sample", 1)
    if num_samples_per_prompt > 1:
        prompt_list = [p for p in prompt_list for _ in range(num_samples_per_prompt)]
        if image_list is not None:
            image_list = [img for img in image_list for _ in range(num_samples_per_prompt)]

    # Handle video input
    video_input_list = None
    if hasattr(model_args, "video"):
        if model_args.start_frame is None or model_args.num_frames is None:
            raise ValueError("Both start_frame and num_frames must be specified when using video input.")
        video_input_list = load_videos(model_args.video, model_args.start_frame, model_args.num_frames)

    # Conditional pixel values
    cond_pixel_paths = getattr(model_args, "conditional_pixel_values_path", None)
    mask_type = getattr(model_args, "mask_type", None)
    hw_crop = getattr(model_args, "crop_for_hw", None)
    max_area = getattr(model_args, "max_hxw", None)
    strength_val = getattr(model_args, "strength", None)

    # Validate consistency
    if image_list is not None and len(prompt_list) != len(image_list):
        raise AssertionError(f"Prompt count ({len(prompt_list)}) ≠ image count ({len(image_list)})")
    if video_input_list is not None and len(prompt_list) != len(video_input_list):
        raise AssertionError(f"Prompt count ({len(prompt_list)}) ≠ video count ({len(video_input_list)})")

    batch_size = model_args.micro_batch_size
    if len(prompt_list) % batch_size != 0:
        raise AssertionError(f"Prompt count ({len(prompt_list)}) not divisible by batch size ({batch_size})")

    fps_out = model_args.fps // model_args.frame_interval

    # Build pipeline
    pipeline = build_inference_pipeline(model_args, target_device)

    # Inference loop over batches
    all_batches = []
    dp_rank = mpu.get_data_parallel_rank()
    dp_world = mpu.get_data_parallel_world_size()
    total_prompts = len(prompt_list)

    for batch_start in range(dp_rank * batch_size, total_prompts, batch_size * dp_world):
        batch_end = batch_start + batch_size
        batch_prompts = prompt_list[batch_start:batch_end]

        batch_kwargs = {}
        if cond_pixel_paths:
            batch_cond_paths = cond_pixel_paths[batch_start:batch_end]
            batch_kwargs.update({
                "conditional_pixel_values_path": batch_cond_paths,
                "mask_type": mask_type,
                "crop_for_hw": hw_crop,
                "max_hxw": max_area
            })

        batch_images = _prepare_batch_data(image_list, batch_start, batch_size) if image_list else None
        batch_videos = _prepare_batch_data(video_input_list, batch_start, batch_size) if video_input_list else None

        generated = pipeline(
            prompt=batch_prompts,
            image=batch_images,
            video=batch_videos,
            fps=fps_out,
            use_prompt_preprocess=getattr(model_args, "use_prompt_preprocess", False),
            device=target_device,
            dtype=target_dtype,
            strength=strength_val,
            **batch_kwargs
        )

        if mpu.get_context_parallel_rank() == 0 and mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank() == 0:
            save_videos(generated, batch_start, model_args.save_path, fps_out)
            all_batches.append(generated)

    # Aggregate results across ranks
    final_tensor = torch.cat(all_batches, dim=0).to(target_device) if all_batches else torch.empty((0,), device=target_device)
    world_size = dist.get_world_size()
    local_rank = dist.get_rank()

    merged_tensor = _broadcast_or_gather_video_grids(final_tensor, world_size, local_rank, target_device)

    if local_rank == 0 and merged_tensor is not None:
        save_video_grid(merged_tensor, model_args.save_path, fps_out)
        print("Inference completed.")
        print(f"Saved {merged_tensor.shape[0]} samples to {model_args.save_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_inference()

from primus.core.patches import PatchContext, register_patch
from primus.modules.module_utils import log_kv_rank_0, log_rank_0

@register_patch(
    "megatron.args.mock_data",
    backend="megatron",
    phase="build_args",
    description="Suppress data file loading in mock simulation mode",
)
def patch_mock_data(ctx: PatchContext):
    """
    Manage mock data configuration.
    When mock_data is active, clears all data path settings to avoid
    Megatron attempting to access real dataset files.
    """
    args = ctx.extra.get("backend_args", {})
    module_config = ctx.extra.get("module_config", {})
    
    if not args or not module_config:
        return
    
    # Check for mock data flag from module parameters
    params = getattr(module_config, "params", None)
    use_mock_data = getattr(params, "mock_data", False) if params else False
    
    if use_mock_data:
        # Clear all data-related paths
        for attr in ["data_path", "train_data_path", "valid_data_path", "test_data_path"]:
            setattr(args, attr, None)
        
        log_rank_0("[Patch:megatron.args.mock_data] Mock data activated; data paths nullified")
    
    # Log current configuration state
    log_kv_rank_0(f"[Patch:megatron.args.mock_data] -use_mock_data", f"{use_mock_data}")
    log_kv_rank_0(f"[Patch:megatron.args.mock_data]   -data_path", f"{args.data_path}")
    log_kv_rank_0(f"[Patch:megatron.args.mock_data]   -train_data_path", f"{args.train_data_path}")
    log_kv_rank_0(f"[Patch:megatron.args.mock_data]   -valid_data_path", f"{args.valid_data_path}")
    log_kv_rank_0(f"[Patch:megatron.args.mock_data]   -test_data_path", f"{args.test_data_path}")

def get_runtime_environment(config, is_trinity: bool = False) -> dict:
    # Load environment variables if .env file exists
    env_file_path = Path(".env")
    if env_file_path.exists():

# Configure logging

    format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(name)s - %(message)s",
    datefmt="%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S",

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Constants
MAX_SEQ_LEN = 10000
DEFAULT_PREFIX = """In 1991, the remains of Russian Tsar Nicholas II and his family
(except for Alexei and Maria) are discovered.
The voice of Nicholas's young son, Tsarevich Alexei Nikolaevich, narrates the
remainder of the story. 1883 Western Siberia,
a young Grigori Rasputin is asked by his father and a group of men to perform magic.
Rasputin has a vision and denounces one of the men as a horse thief. Although his
father initially slaps him for making such an accusation, Rasputin watches as the
man is chased outside and beaten. Twenty years later, Rasputin sees a vision of
the Virgin Mary, prompting him to become a priest. Rasputin quickly becomes famous,
with people, even a bishop, begging for his blessing. <eod> </s> <eos>"""

# Model configuration registry
MODEL_CONFIGS = {
    "gpt2": (GPT2LMHeadModel, GPT2Tokenizer),
    "ctrl": (CTRLLMHeadModel, CTRLTokenizer),
    "openai-gpt": (OpenAIGPTLMHeadModel, OpenAIGPTTokenizer),
    "xlnet": (XLNetLMHeadModel, XLNetTokenizer),
    "transfo-xl": (TransfoXLLMHeadModel, TransfoXLTokenizer),
    "xlm": (XLMWithLMHeadModel, XLMTokenizer),
    "gptj": (GPTJForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer),
    "bloom": (BloomForCausalLM, BloomTokenizerFast),
    "llama": (LlamaForCausalLM, LlamaTokenizer),
    "opt": (OPTForCausalLM, GPT2Tokenizer),
}

# Preprocessing functions for specific model types
def ctrl_preprocess(args, _, tokenizer, text):
    if args.temperature > 0.7:
        log.info("CTRL typically works better with lower temperatures (and lower top_k).")
    encoded = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
    if not any(encoded[0] == x for x in tokenizer.control_codes.values()):
        log.warning("Starting generation without control code may yield suboptimal results")
    return text

def xlm_preprocess(args, model, tokenizer, text):
    use_lang_emb = hasattr(model.config, "use_lang_emb") and model.config.use_lang_emb
    if hasattr(model.config, "lang2id") and use_lang_emb:
        langs = list(model.config.lang2id.keys())
        lang = args.xlm_language if args.xlm_language in langs else None
        while lang not in langs:
            lang = input(f"Select language from {langs} >>> ")
        model.config.lang_id = model.config.lang2id[lang]
    return text

def xlnet_preprocess(args, _, tokenizer, text):
    prefix = args.prefix or args.padding_text or DEFAULT_PREFIX
    return prefix + text

def transfoxl_preprocess(args, _, tokenizer, text):
    prefix = args.prefix or args.padding_text or DEFAULT_PREFIX
    return prefix + text

PREPROCESSORS = {
    "ctrl": ctrl_preprocess,
    "xlm": xlm_preprocess,
    "xlnet": xlnet_preprocess,
    "transfo-xl": transfoxl_preprocess,
}

def adjust_length(length: int, max_seq_len: int) -> int:
    """Adjust generation length based on model constraints"""
    if length < 0:
        return max_seq_len if max_seq_len > 0 else MAX_SEQ_LEN
    return min(length, max_seq_len) if max_seq_len > 0 else length

def extract_model_dims(config) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
    """Extract model dimensions from configuration"""
    # Get embedding size
    embed_size = getattr(config, "hidden_size", 
                        getattr(config, "n_embed", 
                               getattr(config, "n_embd", None)))
    
    # Get number of attention heads
    num_heads = getattr(config, "num_attention_heads", 
                       getattr(config, "n_head", None))
    
    if embed_size is None or num_heads is None or num_heads == 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid model configuration")
    
    # Calculate embedding size per head
    head_dim = embed_size // num_heads
    
    # Get number of layers
    num_layers = getattr(config, "n_layer", 
                        getattr(config, "num_hidden_layers", None))
    if num_layers is None:
        raise ValueError("Could not determine number of layers")
    
    return num_layers, num_heads, head_dim

def create_past_key_values(model, batch_size: int, seq_len: int):
    """Create empty past key values cache"""
    num_layers, num_heads, head_dim = extract_model_dims(model.config)
    
    if model.config.model_type == "bloom":
        # Special handling for BLOOM model
        shape_kv = (int(num_heads * batch_size), head_dim, seq_len)
        shape_q = (int(num_heads * batch_size), seq_len, head_dim)
        return tuple(
            (
                torch.empty(shape_q, dtype=model.dtype, device=model.device),
                torch.empty(shape_kv, dtype=model.dtype, device=model.device),
            )
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        )
    else:
        # Standard shape for other models
        shape = (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
        return tuple(
            (
                torch.empty(shape, dtype=model.dtype, device=model.device),
                torch.empty(shape, dtype=model.dtype, device=model.device),
            )
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        )

def prepare_jit_inputs(batch_inputs, model, tokenizer):
    """Prepare inputs for JIT tracing"""
    batch_size = len(batch_inputs)
    dummy_batch = tokenizer.batch_encode_plus(batch_inputs, return_tensors="pt")
    dummy_batch = {k: v.to(model.device) for k, v in dummy_batch.items()}
    
    if model.config.use_cache:
        dummy_batch["past_key_values"] = create_past_key_values(model, batch_size, 1)
    
    # Extend attention mask for causal modeling
    zeros = torch.zeros((dummy_batch["attention_mask"].shape[0], 1), 
                       dtype=dummy_batch["attention_mask"].dtype, 
                       device=model.device)
    dummy_batch["attention_mask"] = torch.cat([zeros, dummy_batch["attention_mask"]], dim=-1)
    
    return dummy_batch

class OptimizedWrapper(GenerationMixin):
    """Wrapper for optimized model inference"""
    def __init__(self, optimized_model, original_model):
        self._optimized = optimized_model
        self._original = original_model
    
    def __call__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # Initialize past key values if needed
        if kwargs.get("past_key_values") is None and self._original.config.use_cache:
            batch_size = kwargs["input_ids"].shape[0]
            kwargs["past_key_values"] = create_past_key_values(self._original, batch_size, 0)
        
        # Clean up arguments
        kwargs.pop("position_ids", None)
        kwargs = {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if v is not None and not isinstance(v, bool)}
        
        # Run optimized model
        outputs = self._optimized(**kwargs)
        logits, past = outputs[0], outputs[1]
        
        # Format output consistently
        return CausalLMOutputWithPast(
            loss=None,
            logits=logits,
            past_key_values=past,
            hidden_states=None,
            attentions=None,
        )
    
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self._original, name)
    
    def prepare_inputs_for_generation(self, input_ids, **kwargs):
        return self._original.prepare_inputs_for_generation(input_ids, **kwargs)
    
    def _reorder_cache(self, past, beam_idx):
        return self._original._reorder_cache(past, beam_idx)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Text generation with transformer models")
    parser.add_argument("--model_type", type=str, required=True,
                       help=f"Model type from: {', '.join(MODEL_CONFIGS.keys())}")
    parser.add_argument("--model_path", type=str, required=True,
                       help="Path to pre-trained model or model identifier")
    parser.add_argument("--prompt", type=str, default="", help="Input prompt")
    parser.add_argument("--max_length", type=int, default=20, help="Maximum sequence length")
    parser.add_argument("--stop_token", type=str, default=None, help="Token to stop generation")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=1.0, help="Sampling temperature")
    parser.add_argument("--repetition_penalty", type=float, default=1.0, help="Repetition penalty")
    parser.add_argument("--top_k", type=int, default=0, help="Top-k filtering")
    parser.add_argument("--top_p", type=float, default=0.9, help="Top-p filtering")
    parser.add_argument("--prefix", type=str, default="", help="Prefix text")
    parser.add_argument("--padding_text", type=str, default="", help="Deprecated - use prefix")
    parser.add_argument("--xlm_lang", type=str, default="", help="Language for XLM model")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="Random seed")
    parser.add_argument("--cpu", action="store_true", help="Force CPU usage")
    parser.add_argument("--num_seqs", type=int, default=1, help="Number of sequences to generate")
    parser.add_argument("--fp16", action="store_true", help="Use mixed precision")
    parser.add_argument("--jit_trace", action="store_true", help="Enable JIT tracing")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    # Setup distributed state
    state = PartialState(cpu=args.cpu)
    log.info(f"Using device: {state.device}, FP16: {args.fp16}")
    
    # Set random seed
    if args.seed is not None:
        set_seed(args.seed)
    
    # Load model and tokenizer
    try:
        model_type = args.model_type.lower()
        model_cls, tokenizer_cls = MODEL_CONFIGS[model_type]
    except KeyError:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported model type: {args.model_type}")
    
    tokenizer = tokenizer_cls.from_pretrained(args.model_path)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
    
    model = model_cls.from_pretrained(args.model_path)
    model.to(state.device)
    
    if args.fp16:
        model.half()
    
    # Adjust generation length
    max_position = getattr(model.config, "max_position_embeddings", 0)
    args.max_length = adjust_length(args.max_length, max_position)
    
    # Prepare input
    prompt = args.prompt or input("Enter prompt: ")
    
    # Apply preprocessing if needed
    needs_preprocessing = model_type in PREPROCESSORS
    if needs_preprocessing:
        preprocess_fn = PREPROCESSORS[model_type]
        processed_prompt = preprocess_fn(args, model, tokenizer, prompt)
        
        # Handle special tokenizer requirements
        tokenizer_kwargs = {}
        if model.__class__.__name__ == "TransfoXLLMHeadModel":
            tokenizer_kwargs["add_space_before_punct_symbol"] = True
        
        encoded = tokenizer.encode(processed_prompt, add_special_tokens=False, 
                                  return_tensors="pt", **tokenizer_kwargs)
    else:
        prefix = args.prefix or args.padding_text
        encoded = tokenizer.encode(prefix + prompt, add_special_tokens=False, return_tensors="pt")
    
    encoded = encoded.to(state.device)
    input_ids = encoded if encoded.size(-1) > 0 else None
    
    # JIT optimization
    if args.jit_trace:
        jit_texts = ["enable jit"]
        jit_data = prepare_jit_inputs(jit_texts, model, tokenizer)
        
        torch._C._jit_set_texpr_fuser_enabled(False)
        model.config.return_dict = False
        
        sig = inspect.signature(model.forward if hasattr(model, "forward") else model.__call__)
        jit_tuple = tuple(jit_data[k] for k in sig.parameters if jit_data.get(k) is not None)
        
        traced = torch.jit.trace(model, jit_tuple, strict=False)
        traced = torch.jit.freeze(traced.eval())
        traced(*jit_tuple)
        traced(*jit_tuple)
        
        model = OptimizedWrapper(traced, model)
    
    # Generate text
    output = model.generate(
        input_ids=input_ids,
        max_length=args.max_length + (encoded.size(-1) if encoded is not None else 0),
        temperature=args.temperature,
        top_k=args.top_k,
        top_p=args.top_p,
        repetition_penalty=args.repetition_penalty,
        do_sample=True,
        num_return_sequences=args.num_seqs,
    )
    
    # Process outputs
    if len(output.shape) > 2:
        output.squeeze_()
    
    generated_texts = []
    for idx, seq in enumerate(output):
        print(f"\n=== GENERATED SEQUENCE {idx + 1} ===")
        seq_list = seq.tolist()
        
        # Decode tokens
        decoded = tokenizer.decode(seq_list, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=True)
        
        # Stop at token if specified
        if args.stop_token:
            decoded = decoded[:decoded.find(args.stop_token)]
        
        # Combine with original prompt
        full_text = prompt + decoded[len(tokenizer.decode(encoded[0], clean_up_tokenization_spaces=True)):]
        generated_texts.append(full_text)
        print(full_text)
    
    return generated_texts

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession, functions as F, types as T

def build_calendar_dimension(spark: SparkSession, start: str, finish: str, holiday_list=None):
    """
    Constructs a comprehensive calendar dimension (DimDate) covering [start, finish] inclusive.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    spark : SparkSession
    start : str in 'YYYY-MM-DD'
    finish : str in 'YYYY-MM-DD'
    holiday_list : Optional[List[str]] list of holiday dates ('YYYY-MM-DD')
    
    Returns
    -------
    pyspark.sql.DataFrame : Calendar dimension with standard BI columns
    """
    # Generate sequence of dates using range + explode pattern
    base_dates = (
        spark.range(1)
        .select(
            F.explode(
                F.sequence(
                    F.to_date(F.lit(start)),
                    F.to_date(F.lit(finish)),
                    F.interval(days=1)
                )
            ).alias("calendar_date")
        )
    )

    # Extract weekday info (ISO: Monday=1 ... Sunday=7)
    weekday_expr = F.date_format("calendar_date", "u").cast("int")
    
    # Build core date components
    calendar_df = (
        base_dates
        .withColumn("dow_iso", weekday_expr)
        .withColumn("day_name", F.date_format("calendar_date", "EEEE"))
        .withColumn("dom", F.dayofmonth("calendar_date"))
        .withColumn("doy", F.dayofyear("calendar_date"))
        .withColumn("month_num", F.month("calendar_date"))
        .withColumn("month_name", F.date_format("calendar_date", "MMMM"))
        .withColumn("yr", F.year("calendar_date"))
        .withColumn("woy", F.weekofyear("calendar_date"))
    )

    # Compute week boundaries (Mon–Sun)
    calendar_df = (
        calendar_df
        .withColumn("week_start", F.date_sub("calendar_date", F.col("dow_iso") - 1))
        .withColumn("week_end", F.date_add("week_start", 6))
    )

    # Month boundaries
    calendar_df = (
        calendar_df
        .withColumn("month_start", F.trunc("calendar_date", "MM"))
        .withColumn("month_end", F.last_day("calendar_date"))
    )

    # Quarter logic
    qtr_num = F.quarter("calendar_date")
    qtr_start_date = F.to_date(
        F.concat_ws("-",
            F.year("calendar_date"),
            ((qtr_num - 1) * 3 + 1).cast("int"),
            F.lit(1)
        ),
        "yyyy-M-d"
    )
    calendar_df = (
        calendar_df
        .withColumn("qtr_num", qtr_num)
        .withColumn("qtr_label", F.concat(F.lit("Q"), qtr_num))
        .withColumn("qtr_start", qtr_start_date)
        .withColumn("qtr_end", F.last_day(F.add_months(qtr_start_date, 2)))
    )

    # Year boundaries
    calendar_df = (
        calendar_df
        .withColumn("year_start", F.to_date(F.concat_ws("-", F.year("calendar_date"), F.lit(1), F.lit(1))))
        .withColumn("year_end", F.to_date(F.concat_ws("-", F.year("calendar_date"), F.lit(12), F.lit(31))))
    )

    # Derived flags & formatted strings
    calendar_df = (
        calendar_df
        .withColumn("is_weekend", F.when(F.col("dow_iso").isin([6, 7]), True).otherwise(False))
        .withColumn("is_leap", ((F.year("calendar_date") % 4 == 0) & (F.year("calendar_date") % 100 != 0)) | (F.year("calendar_date") % 400 == 0))
        .withColumn("y_m", F.date_format("calendar_date", "yyyy-MM"))
        .withColumn("iso_yr_wk", F.concat(
            F.date_format("calendar_date", "yyyy"),
            F.lit("-"),
            F.lpad(F.weekofyear("calendar_date").cast("string"), 2, "0")
        ))
        .withColumn("yyyymm", F.date_format("calendar_date", "yyyyMM").cast("int"))
        .withColumn("yyyy_q", F.concat(F.date_format("calendar_date", "yyyy"), F.lit("-Q"), qtr_num))
    )

    # Surrogate key: YYYYMMDD as integer
    calendar_df = calendar_df.withColumn("date_id", F.date_format("calendar_date", "yyyyMMdd").cast("int"))

    # Handle holidays if provided
    if holiday_list:
        hol_df = spark.createDataFrame(
            [(h,) for h in holiday_list],
            T.StructType([T.StructField("hol_dt", T.DateType(), nullable=False)])
        ).withColumn("holiday_flag", F.lit(True))

        calendar_df = (
            calendar_df
            .join(hol_df, calendar_df.calendar_date == hol_df.hol_dt, how="left")
            .withColumn("is_holiday", F.coalesce(F.col("holiday_flag"), F.lit(False)))
            .drop("hol_dt", "holiday_flag")
        )
    else:
        calendar_df = calendar_df.withColumn("is_holiday", F.lit(False))

    # Final column selection and ordering
    final_cols = [
        "date_id", "calendar_date",
        "dow_iso", "day_name", "dom", "doy",
        "woy", "week_start", "week_end",
        "month_num", "month_name", "month_start", "month_end",
        "qtr_num", "qtr_label", "qtr_start", "qtr_end",
        "yr", "year_start", "year_end",
        "is_weekend", "is_holiday", "is_leap",
        "y_m", "iso_yr_wk", "yyyymm", "yyyy_q"
    ]
    
    return calendar_df.select(*final_cols)

# Type III Clone: SQLX Resource Extractor (Refactored Logic)

import re
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Any

class SQLXResourceExtractor:
    """
    A lightweight, static extractor for Dataform SQLX projects.
    This implementation avoids execution or compilation and instead performs
    a best-effort parse of `.sqlx` files to extract:
      - table-like actions (tables/views/incrementals)
      - configuration metadata (tags, uniqueKey, warehouse-specific settings)
      - column definitions and documentation when statically declared
      - dependencies via `ref("...")` calls
      - pre_operations blocks for incremental logic
    """
    
    def __init__(self, project_directory: str):
        self.project_root = Path(project_directory)
        self.extracted_data = {
            "tables": [],
            "assertions": [],
            "operations": [],
            "declarations": [],
        }
        self.column_registry = defaultdict(list)
        self.document_registry = defaultdict(str)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Public Interface
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def collect_all_resources(self) -> Tuple[Dict[str, List[dict]], dict, dict]:
        """Gather all SQLX resources from the project directory."""
        self._process_sqlx_files()
        
        # Normalize paths relative to project root
        for resource_category in self.extracted_data:
            for item in self.extracted_data[resource_category]:
                original_path = item.get("path")
                if not isinstance(original_path, str) or not original_path:
                    continue
                try:
                    full_path = Path(original_path).resolve()
                    rel_path = full_path.relative_to(self.project_root.resolve())
                    item["path"] = str(rel_path)
                except ValueError:
                    # Path outside project root — retain original value
                    pass
        return self.extracted_data, self.column_registry, self.document_registry
    
    def get_counts(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        """Return summary counts of discovered resources by type."""
        return {category: len(entries) for category, entries in self.extracted_data.items()}

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Internal Processing Helpers
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _process_sqlx_files(self) -> None:
        """Discover and process all `.sqlx` files under the project root."""
        sqlx_paths = list(self.project_root.glob("**/*.sqlx"))
        for file_path in sqlx_paths:
            try:
                with file_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    source_text = f.read()
            except Exception:
                continue
            
            base_name = file_path.stem
            config_section, remaining_content = self._grab_enclosed_block(source_text, "config")
            pre_ops_section, main_sql = self._grab_enclosed_block(remaining_content, "pre_operations")
            
            parsed_config = self._analyze_config_section(config_section)
            referenced_items = self._find_references(source_text)
            
            # Construct table-like resource record
            table_entry: dict = {
                "name": base_name,
                "path": str(file_path),
                "kind": "dataform_table",
                "mode": parsed_config.get("type", ""),
                "comment": parsed_config.get("description", ""),
                "labels": parsed_config.get("tags", []),
                "schema_expr": parsed_config.get("schema_expr", ""),
                "primary_keys": parsed_config.get("unique_key", []),
                "partition_field": parsed_config.get("partition_by"),
                "cluster_fields": parsed_config.get("cluster_by", []),
                "validation_rules": parsed_config.get("assertions", {}),
                "query_body": main_sql.strip() if isinstance(main_sql, str) else "",
                "pre_ops_raw": pre_ops_section.strip() if isinstance(pre_ops_section, str) else "",
                "full_source": source_text,
                "dependencies": referenced_items,
                "raw_config_data": parsed_config.get("raw_config", {}),
            }
            
            col_list = parsed_config.get("columns", [])
            if col_list:
                table_entry["column_details"] = col_list
            
            self.extracted_data["tables"].append(table_entry)
            
            # Maintain auxiliary mappings for columns/docs
            if col_list:
                key = f"dataform_table.{base_name}"
                for col in col_list:
                    self.column_registry[key].append(col)
            
            doc_text = table_entry.get("comment")
            if doc_text:
                self.document_registry[f"dataform_table.{base_name}"] = doc_text

    def _grab_enclosed_block(self, text: str, label: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
        """
        Locate and extract a top-level `{ ... }` block following a keyword.
        Returns:
          (inner_content_without_braces, rest_of_text_after_extraction)
        If no match found, returns ("", original_text).
        """
        regex = re.compile(rf"{label}\s*\{{", re.IGNORECASE)
        match = regex.search(text)
        if not match:
            return "", text
        
        start_pos = match.start()
        brace_start = text.find("{", match.start())
        if brace_start == -1:
            return "", text
        
        depth = 0
        end_pos = None
        for i in range(brace_start, len(text)):
            char = text[i]
            if char == "{":
                depth += 1
            elif char == "}":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    end_pos = i
                    break
        
        if end_pos is None:
            return "", text
        
        inner = text[brace_start + 1:end_pos]
        remainder = text[:start_pos] + text[end_pos + 1:]
        return inner.strip(), remainder

    def _analyze_config_section(self, section: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Conservative parser for the SQLX `config { ... }` block.
        Extracts commonly used fields and preserves raw content for inspection.
        """
        if not section:
            return {
                "raw_config": {},
                "columns": [],
                "tags": [],
                "assertions": {},
                "cluster_by": [],
                "unique_key": [],
            }

        lines = [line.strip() for line in section.splitlines() 
                 if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith("//")]
        
        result: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "raw_config": {"__raw_text__": section},
            "columns": [],
            "tags": [],
            "assertions": {},
            "cluster_by": [],
            "unique_key": [],
        }

        def _get_string_value(pattern: str) -> str:
            for line in lines:
                m = re.search(pattern, line)
                if m:
                    return m.group(1)
            return ""

        def _get_string_array(pattern: str) -> List[str]:
            for line in lines:
                m = re.search(pattern, line)
                if not m:
                    continue
                inner = m.group(1)
                parts = [p.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for p in inner.split(",") if p.strip()]
                return parts
            return []

        # Extract known fields
        result["type"] = _get_string_value(r'type\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']')
        result["description"] = _get_string_value(r'description\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']')
        
        schema_line = ""
        for line in lines:
            if line.startswith("schema"):
                parts = line.split(":", 1)
                if len(parts) == 2:
                    schema_line = parts[1].rstrip(",").strip()
                break
        result["schema_expr"] = schema_line
        
        result["tags"] = _get_string_array(r"tags\s*:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]")
        
        primary_keys = _get_string_array(r"uniqueKey\s*:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]")
        if not primary_keys:
            primary_keys = _get_string_array(r"uniqueKey\s*:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]")
        result["unique_key"] = primary_keys
        
        result["partition_by"] = _get_string_value(r'partitionBy\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']')
        result["cluster_by"] = _get_string_array(r"clusterBy\s*:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]")
        
        # Parse columns block
        cols: List[dict] = []
        col_block = self._extract_nested_block(section, "columns")
        if col_block:
            col_lines = [
                ln.strip() for ln in col_block.splitlines() 
                if ln.strip() and not ln.strip().startswith("//")
            ]
            for ln in col_lines:
                m = re.match(r"([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*:\s*['\"]([^'\"]*)['\"]", ln)
                if not m:
                    continue
                cols.append({
                    "name": m.group(1),
                    "description": m.group(2),
                    "data_type": "",
                    "meta": {},
                })
        result["columns"] = cols
        
        # Assertions block
        assertion_block = self._extract_nested_block(section, "assertions")
        if assertion_block:
            result["assertions"]["__raw_text__"] = assertion_block
        
        return result

    def _extract_nested_block(self, text: str, key: str) -> str:
        """Extract a `{ ... }` block associated with a key inside another block."""
        pattern = re.compile(rf"{key}\s*:\s*\{{", re.IGNORECASE)
        match = pattern.search(text)
        if not match:
            return ""
        
        brace_start = text.find("{", match.start())
        if brace_start == -1:
            return ""
        
        depth = 0
        end_pos = None
        for i in range(brace_start, len(text)):
            char = text[i]
            if char == "{":
                depth += 1
            elif char == "}":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    end_pos = i
                    break
        
        if end_pos is None:
            return ""
        return text[brace_start + 1:end_pos].strip()

    def _find_references(self, source: str) -> List[str]:
        """Find all ref(...) calls and return deduplicated names in order."""
        matches = re.findall(r'ref\(\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']\s*\)', source)
        seen = set()
        ordered_refs = []
        for ref in matches:
            if ref not in seen:
                seen.add(ref)
                ordered_refs.append(ref)
        return ordered_refs

"""
Data Preprocessing Pipeline for Tokenization & Dataset Construction

This module handles JSONL → tokenized binary dataset conversion,
optionally splitting documents into sentences first.
"""

import argparse

import json

from functools import partial
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any

# Add parent directory to path for imports

    os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), os.pardir))
)

try:

except ImportError:
    PunktLanguageVars = object

from megatron.core.datasets import indexed_dataset

class CustomPunctuation(PunktLanguageVars):
    """Custom punctuation rules to preserve newlines after sentence boundaries."""
    _period_context_fmt = r"""
        \S*                          # some word material
        %(SentEndChars)s             # a potential sentence ending
        \s*                          # <-- relaxed whitespace
        (?=(?P<after_tok>
            %(NonWord)s              # either other punctuation
            |
            (?P<next_tok>\S+)        # <-- next token directly after optional space
        ))"""


class SentenceBreaker:
    """Handles sentence segmentation using NLTK or identity fallback."""

    def __init__(self, lang: str, keep_newlines: bool):
        self.lang = lang
        self.keep_newlines = keep_newlines
        if not NLTK_AVAILABLE:
            raise RuntimeError("NLTK is required for sentence splitting but not installed.")
        if NLTK_AVAILABLE:
            nltk.download("punkt", quiet=True, download_dir=os.environ.get("NLTK_DATA"))
            nltk.download("punkt_tab", quiet=True)
        self._setup_splitter()

    def _setup_splitter(self):
        library_path = os.path.join("tokenizers", "punkt", f"{self.lang}.pickle")
        url = f"nltk:{library_path}"
        try:
            if os.getenv("NLTK_DATA"):
                lib = os.path.join(os.getenv("NLTK_DATA"), "tokenizers", "punkt", f"{self.lang}.pickle")
                url = f"file:{lib}"
            punkt_params = nltk.load(url)._params
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to load NLTK punkt model: {e}")

        if self.keep_newlines:
            self.splitter = nltk.tokenize.punkt.PunktSentenceTokenizer(
                train_text=punkt_params, lang_vars=CustomPunctuation()
            )
        else:
            self.splitter = nltk.tokenize.punkt.PunktSentenceTokenizer(train_text=punkt_params)

    def segment(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """Split input text into sentences."""
        max_chunk = 1_000_000
        segments = []
        for i in range(0, len(text), max_chunk):
            chunk = text[i:i + max_chunk]
            segments.extend(self.splitter.tokenize(chunk))
        return segments


class TokenizerWrapper:
    """Encapsulates tokenizer setup and application."""

    def __init__(self, args):
        self.tokenizer = build_tokenizer(args)
        self.eod_id = getattr(self.tokenizer, "eod", None)

    def encode(self, sentence: str) -> List[int]:
        """Tokenize a single sentence."""
        tokens = self.tokenizer.tokenize(sentence)
        if tokens and self.eod_id is not None:
            tokens.append(self.eod_id)
        return tokens


def process_partition(
    input_path: str,
    output_prefix: str,
    keys: List[str],
    split_sentences: bool,
    append_eod: bool,
    lang: str,
    keep_newlines: bool,
    log_interval: int,
    worker_id: int,
) -> None:
    """Process a single partitioned input file."""
    print(f"[Worker {worker_id}] Processing: {input_path}")
    start_time = time.time()
    total_bytes = 0
    line_count = 0

    # Initialize components
    splitter = SentenceBreaker(lang, keep_newlines) if split_sentences else None
    tokenizer = TokenizerWrapper(type("", (), {
        "tokenizer_type": "mock",
        "vocab_size": 50257,
        "append_eod": append_eod,
    })())

    # Prepare output builders
    builders: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    bin_paths: Dict[str, str] = {}
    idx_paths: Dict[str, str] = {}
    level = "sentence" if split_sentences else "document"

    for key in keys:
        bin_paths[key] = f"{output_prefix}_{key}_{level}.bin"
        idx_paths[key] = f"{output_prefix}_{key}_{level}.idx"
        builders[key] = indexed_dataset.IndexedDatasetBuilder(
            bin_paths[key],
            dtype=indexed_dataset.DType.optimal_dtype(tokenizer.tokenizer.vocab_size),
        )

    # Open input file (support .gz)
    opener = gzip.open if input_path.endswith(".gz") else open
    with opener(input_path, "rt", encoding="utf-8") as fin:
        for line_num, raw_line in enumerate(fin, start=1):
            try:
                data = json.loads(raw_line)
                total_bytes += len(raw_line.encode("utf-8"))

                for key in keys:
                    content = data.get(key, "")
                    if isinstance(content, list):
                        sentences = content
                    else:
                        sentences = [content]

                    if split_sentences:
                        sentences = sum([splitter.segment(s) for s in sentences], [])

                    doc_ids = []
                    lens = []

                    for sent in sentences:
                        ids = tokenizer.encode(sent)
                        if ids:
                            doc_ids.extend(ids)
                            lens.append(len(ids))

                    if doc_ids and append_eod:
                        lens[-1] += 1

                    builders[key].add_document(doc_ids, lens)

                if line_num % log_interval == 0:
                    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
                    speed = line_num / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
                    mbs = total_bytes / elapsed / 1024 / 1024 if elapsed > 0 else 0
                    print(f"[Worker {worker_id}] Processed {line_num} lines "
                          f"({speed:.1f} docs/s, {mbs:.1f} MB/s)", file=sys.stderr)

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[Worker {worker_id}] Error at line {line_num}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                continue

    # Finalize builders
    for key in keys:
        builders[key].finalize(idx_paths[key])

    print(f"[Worker {worker_id}] Completed in {time.time() - start_time:.1f}s")


def split_file_into_partitions(
    input_pattern: str,
    output_prefix: str,
    num_parts: int,
    keep_sequential: bool,
) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    """Partition input files into multiple shards."""
    files = glob.glob(input_pattern)
    if not files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No files matched pattern: {input_pattern}")

    total_lines = 0
    if keep_sequential:
        for fname in files:
            with open(fname, "r") as f:
                total_lines += sum(1 for _ in f)
        part_size = math.ceil(total_lines / num_parts)

    partitions = []
    current_part_idx = 0
    current_lines = 0

    for src in files:
        opener = gzip.open if src.endswith(".gz") else open
        with opener(src, "rt", encoding="utf-8") as src_f:
            dst_name = f"{output_prefix}_part_{current_part_idx}.jsonl"
            with open(dst_name, "w", encoding="utf-8") as dst_f:
                for line in src_f:
                    dst_f.write(line)
                    if keep_sequential:
                        current_lines += 1
                        if current_lines >= part_size and current_part_idx < num_parts - 1:
                            current_part_idx += 1
                            current_lines = 0
                            dst_f.close()
                            dst_name = f"{output_prefix}_part_{current_part_idx}.jsonl"
                            dst_f = open(dst_name, "w", encoding="utf-8")
            dst_f.close()
        partitions.append((dst_name, dst_name.replace("_part_", "_ss_part_")))

    return partitions


def parse_arguments() -> argparse.Namespace:
    """Parse and validate command-line arguments."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Preprocess JSONL data for training.")
    parser = _add_tokenizer_args(parser)

    group = parser.add_argument_group("Input Data")
    group.add_argument("--input", type=str, required=True, help="Input JSONL file or glob pattern.")
    group.add_argument("--json-keys", nargs="+", default=["text"], help="Keys to extract from each JSON object.")
    group.add_argument("--split-sentences", action="store_true", help="Split documents into sentences before tokenizing.")
    group.add_argument("--keep-newlines", action="store_true", help="Preserve newlines during sentence splitting.")

    group = parser.add_argument_group("Tokenization")
    group.add_argument("--append-eod", action="store_true", help="Append end-of-document token.")
    group.add_argument("--lang", type=str, default="english", help="Language for sentence splitting.")

    group = parser.add_argument_group("Output")
    group.add_argument("--output-prefix", type=str, required=True, help="Prefix for output files.")

    group = parser.add_argument_group("Runtime")
    group.add_argument("--workers", type=int, required=True, help="Number of parallel workers.")
    group.add_argument("--partitions", type=int, default=1, help="Number of input file partitions.")
    group.add_argument("--log-interval", type=int, default=1000, help="Logging frequency.")
    group.add_argument("--keep-sequential-samples", action="store_true", help="Maintain sample order across partitions.")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Validate
    if args.tokenizer_type.lower().startswith("bert") and not args.split_sentences:
        print("Warning: BERT models typically benefit from sentence splitting.", file=sys.stderr)

    # Dummy defaults for tokenizer compatibility
    args.rank = 1
    args.make_vocab_size_divisible_by = 128
    args.tensor_model_parallel_size = 1
    args.vocab_extra_ids = 0

    return args


def main():
    args = parse_arguments()

    # Setup logging (minimal replacement for logger)
    print(f"[INFO] Starting preprocessing with {args.workers} workers on {args.partitions} partitions.")

    # Handle partitioning
    if args.partitions > 1:
        partitions = split_file_into_partitions(
            args.input,
            args.output_prefix,
            args.partitions,
            args.keep_sequential_samples,
        )
    else:
        base_name = os.path.splitext(args.input)[0]
        partitions = [(args.input, f"{base_name}_ss.jsonl")]

    # Launch workers
    processes = []
    for idx, (in_path, _) in enumerate(partitions):
        p = multiprocessing.Process(
            target=process_partition,
            args=(
                in_path,
                f"{args.output_prefix}_part_{idx}",
                args.json_keys,
                args.split_sentences,
                args.append_eod,
                args.lang,
                args.keep_newlines,
                args.log_interval,
                idx,
            ),
        )
        p.start()
        processes.append(p)

    for p in processes:
        p.join()

    # Merge outputs if needed
    if args.partitions > 1:
        merge_outputs(args, partitions)


def merge_outputs(args, partitions):
    """Merge binary/idx files across partitions."""
    level = "sentence" if args.split_sentences else "document"
    tokenizer = build_tokenizer(args)

    for key in args.json_keys:
        builder = indexed_dataset.IndexedDatasetBuilder(
            f"{args.output_prefix}_{key}_{level}.bin",
            dtype=indexed_dataset.DType.optimal_dtype(tokenizer.vocab_size),
        )
        for idx, (_, _) in enumerate(partitions):
            prefix = f"{args.output_prefix}_part_{idx}_{key}_{level}"
            builder.add_index(prefix)
        builder.finalize(f"{args.output_prefix}_{key}_{level}.idx")

    main()

        if hasattr(self.graph_db, "driver") and hasattr(self.graph_db, "db_name"):
            print("Using Neo4j driver for direct ping...")
            try:
                with self.graph_db.driver.session(database=self.graph_db.db_name) as session:

                    session.run("RETURN 1").single()
                    for _ in range(trials):
                        start_time = time.time()
                        session.run("RETURN 1").single()
                        latencies.append((time.time() - start_time) * 1000)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Direct driver ping failed: {e}. Falling back to get_node.")
                latencies = []

        if not latencies:
            # Fallback to get_node with non-existent ID
            print("Using get_node for ping...")
            for _ in range(trials):
                probe_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                start_time = time.time()
                self.graph_db.get_node(probe_id, user_name=self.user_name)
                latencies.append((time.time() - start_time) * 1000)

        print(f"Average Network RTT: {avg_rtt:.2f} ms")
        return avg_rtt

def fully_shard_by_dtype(module, mesh, mp_policy, offload_policy):
    # Collect parameters grouped by their data types
    dtype_groups = {}
    for param_name, param in module.named_parameters():
        dtype = param.dtype
        if dtype not in dtype_groups:
            dtype_groups[dtype] = []
        dtype_groups[dtype].append(param)
    
    # Handle case with no parameters
    if not dtype_groups:
        return
    
    # Single dtype case: shard entire module
    if len(dtype_groups) == 1:
        fully_shard(module, mesh=mesh, mp_policy=mp_policy, offload_policy=offload_policy)
        return
    
    # Multiple dtypes case: find smallest group and process subtrees
    smallest_dtype = min(dtype_groups.items(), key=lambda kv: len(kv[1]))[0]
    
    # Process maximal uniform dtype subtrees
    for subtree_path, submodule, subtree_dtype in iter_maximal_uniform_dtype_subtrees(
        module,
        tensor_pred=torch.is_floating_point,
        return_paths=True,
    ):
        # Determine if this subtree should be sharded
        should_shard = (
            (len(dtype_groups) == 2 and subtree_dtype == smallest_dtype) or 
            len(dtype_groups) > 2
        )
        
        if should_shard:
            # Navigate to the submodule using its path
            target_module = module
            for part in subtree_path.split('.'):
                if part:  # skip empty parts
                    target_module = getattr(target_module, part)
            
            # Apply FSDP to the identified submodule
            _fully_shard(
                target_module,
                mesh=mesh,
                mp_policy=mp_policy,
                offload_policy=offload_policy,

    # For two-dtype case, also shard the entire module
    if len(dtype_groups) == 2:
        fully_shard(module, mesh=mesh, mp_policy=mp_policy, offload_policy=offload_policy)

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.args = args
        self.kwargs = kwargs
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
    def forward(self, x: jax.numpy.ndarray) -> jax.numpy.ndarray:
        return {func_path}(x, *self.args, **self.kwargs)
"""

import os
import contextlib
import tempfile
import shutil
import logging
import time
import random
from typing import Generator, Any

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Retry configuration parameters
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
INITIAL_WAIT = 0.1  # seconds

@contextlib.contextmanager
def safe_file_write(
    target_path: str, 
    open_mode: str = "w", 
    text_encoding: str = "utf-8", 
    **open_kwargs: Any
) -> Generator[Any, None, None]:
    """
    Context manager for performing atomic file updates.
    
    Writes content to a temporary file in the same directory as the target,
    then performs an atomic replacement operation. Ensures durability by
    synchronizing data to disk before renaming.
    
    Args:
        target_path: Final destination path for the file
        open_mode: Mode to open the file (default 'w')
        text_encoding: Character encoding for text mode (default 'utf-8')
        **open_kwargs: Additional arguments passed to open()
        
    Yields:
        File object suitable for writing operations
    """
    # Determine parent directory and filename components
    dir_path = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(target_path))
    file_name = os.path.basename(target_path)
    
    # Create directory structure if needed
    if dir_path and not os.path.isdir(dir_path):
        os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Generate unique temporary filename
    temp_prefix = f".{file_name}_"
    fd, temp_file_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
        dir=dir_path, 
        prefix=temp_prefix, 
        suffix=".tmp",
        text=("b" not in open_mode)
    )
    
    file_obj = None
    try:
        # Wrap file descriptor with Python file object
        file_obj = os.fdopen(
            fd, 
            open_mode, 
            encoding=text_encoding if "b" not in open_mode else None, 
            **open_kwargs
        )
        
        # Provide file handle to caller
        yield file_obj
        
        # Ensure all buffered data reaches OS
        file_obj.flush()
        
        # Force OS-level write to storage
        os.fsync(file_obj.fileno())
        
        # Close file before moving it
        file_obj.close()
        file_obj = None  # Avoid double-close
        
        # Preserve original permissions if file already exists
        if os.path.isfile(target_path):
            try:
                shutil.copystat(target_path, temp_file_path)
            except OSError as perm_error:
                logger.warning(f"Unable to preserve permissions for {target_path}: {perm_error}")
        
        # Perform atomic move with retry mechanism
        _perform_atomic_move(temp_file_path, target_path)
            
    except Exception as exc:
        # Cleanup on failure
        if file_obj is not None:
            try:
                file_obj.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        # Remove temporary file if it still exists
        if os.path.exists(temp_file_path):
            try:
                os.unlink(temp_file_path)
            except OSError as cleanup_exc:
                logger.warning(f"Cleanup failed for {temp_file_path}: {cleanup_exc}")
                
        raise exc

def _perform_atomic_move(source: str, destination: str) -> None:
    """
    Attempt to atomically move source file to destination with retries.
    
    Handles transient file lock issues common on Windows systems.
    Uses exponential backoff with jitter between attempts.
    """
    latest_exception = None
    
    for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
        try:
            # Use os.replace for atomic semantics across platforms
            os.replace(source, destination)
            return
        except OSError as err:
            latest_exception = err
            # Log diagnostic info for debugging
            logger.debug(
                f"Atomic move attempt {attempt}/{MAX_ATTEMPTS} failed: {err}"
            )
            
            # Calculate wait time with jitter
            base_delay = INITIAL_WAIT * attempt
            jitter = random.uniform(0, 0.1)
            total_delay = base_delay + jitter
            time.sleep(total_delay)
            
    # Exhausted all retries - raise final error
    raise OSError(
        f"Atomic file replacement failed after {MAX_ATTEMPTS} tries. "
        f"Last error: {latest_exception}"
    ) from latest_exception
